items.title: 〈房產〉AI供應鏈擴廠熱絡 商仲：全年商用不動產交易向上挑戰3000億元
items.title_en: <Real Estate> AI Supply Chain Expansion Fuels Hot Market; Commercial Real Estate Transactions Could Challenge NT$3 Trillion This Year
paras: 商仲第一太平戴維斯統計指出，2026年第三季大型商用不動產(單筆交易3億元以上)交易金額達899億元，累計1-3季達2,577億元，創下歷史新高，比去年同期大增109%。相較之下，土地市場受住宅買氣疲弱與開發商購地趨於審慎影響，交易規模持續收斂，第三季交易金額僅229億元，累計1-3季為1,037億元，年減23%，商用不動產與土地市場明顯分化。

第一太平戴維斯董事長黃瑞楠表示，AI產業的硬體投資動能持續為台灣科技業帶來龐大商機，並已由前端晶片需求進一步延伸至資料中心與基礎設施建置，帶動相關產業鏈同步受惠。接下來邁入第四季交易旺季，於經濟產業K型分化下，科技業擴產需求強勁，部分傳產業者藉由這股利多積極活化廠房，並希望在年底前完成交易，供給與需求同步增溫下，預期全年大型商用不動產交易金額有機會挑戰3,000億元，呈現跳躍式成長，並寫下歷史新高。
此一走勢主要受惠於AI應用需求持續擴大，台灣出口與企業投資動能維持強勁，主計總處於8月再度上修2026年經濟成長率預測至11.05%，創下1988年以來新高。在半導體及電子產業持續擴充產能帶動下，企業自用廠房需求升溫，支撐商用不動產市場交易動能創下新高。
第一太平戴維斯指出，第三季前三大指標交易包含凱基人壽以206億元向潤泰新(9945-TW)購買潤泰玉成廣場整棟商辦、廣達電腦(2382-TW)以197億購置華亞科廠房和日月光(3711-TW)以63億購置南科高雄園區廠房，儘管商用不動產交易金額寫下歷史新高，不同產品類型的表現呈K型發展的現象。
而2026年1-8月外銷訂單金額年增55%，科技業持續擴大資本支出，推升廠房交易表現一枝獨秀。2026年第三季廠房交易金額達602億元，占第三季商用不動產交易比重近70%，累計1-3季達1,920億元，較去年同期成長近3倍。隨著AI應用需求持續擴大，從半導體製造到資料中心及相關基礎設施建置，均帶動供應鏈業者加速擴產布局，展現更積極的擴廠需求。
2026年第三季最大廠房交易為電腦及周邊設備製造業的廣達電腦斥資197億元購入華亞科技園區廠房，作為AI伺服器產線布局；光學器材製造業大廠大立光(2383-TW)積極在台中擴產，自6月至9月間陸續購入7筆台中工業區及台中精密機械科技創新園區廠房，累計交易金額達80億元，合計取得近1.7萬坪的土地。隨著科技大廠加速擴廠，台中工業區內觀察到明顯漲幅，帶動區內土地單價近半年上漲約1成。
進一步觀察廠房交易區域，2026年1-3季交易熱區為苗栗縣及桃園市，交易金額分別達690億元及549億元。其中，苗栗縣因具備大面積廠房取得條件，同時受惠於新竹科學園區產業外溢效應，罕見躍居全台廠房交易重鎮，除第一季美光高達528億元的指標交易案帶動外，包括矽品、信邦(3023-TW)等科技業者亦持續於當地布局，且單一交易規模都超過20億元，苗栗縣逐漸成為科技業布局的重要區域。
2026年第三季辦公室交易排名第二，交易金額達265.5億元，占商用不動產交易約30%，累計1-3季達463.8億元，購置動能回升。最大貢獻來自凱基人壽以206億元購入潤泰玉成廣場整棟大樓，創下歷年來最大筆的辦公室交易案，拆算建物單價約每坪112.5萬元。賣方採售後回租模式，且目前已有輝達等知名科技企業承租逾半棟辦公空間，預估投報率可達3%，符合今年保險業不動產最低投報率2.72%的門檻。
雖然第三季央行利率維持不變，依照保險業相關規範，即使第四季利率不變，明年保險業投報率門檻將提高至2.895%；若第四季升息半碼或1碼，門檻將分別升至2.92%及2.945%之間。這也促使保險業在投報率提升前，提前布局於精華地區及具收益穩定的不動產，預期明年投報率提升後，投資機會將更有限。
同時，土地市場交易方面，2026年建商推案、住宅開工戶數及預售屋成交量皆減少約20%，土地交易規模也持續萎縮。第三季土地交易金額為229億元，累計前三季交易金額為1,037億元，較去年同期減少23%。受住宅市場低迷影響，建商購地態度審慎，本季僅投入126億元，累計1-3季購地金額為530億元，年減40%，開發商短期內仍以去化餘屋為優先考量。
儘管整體市場偏弱，指標建商對於具規模效益及區位優勢的大型開發案仍維持布局意願。其中，開明高職土地案為本季最大交易，海悅(2348-TW)、新美齊(2442-TW)與濟盟建設組成合作聯盟，於2024年取得部分土地後，本季再以35.2億元購入4筆土地進行整合，累計投資金額達90億元、總面積達3,923坪，未來將以都市更新模式推動開發。
坤悅開發(5206-TW)則繼上一季以11.2億元取得台中七期土地後，2026年第三季再以10.5億元向關係人購入同街廓基地，累計取得土地面積達722坪，土地單價皆達每坪300萬元，持續擴大並整合七期核心區布局。
台灣央行日前宣布放寬信用管制，為房市注入暖流，放寬項目包括將第二戶房貸成數上限由6成提高至7成，並取消建商18個月開工期限相關規定，預期新規定將使住宅買氣止跌回升，但觀察近五年建商購地金額，2024年仍高達1,659億元，這也隱含建商土地庫存還算充足，短期內因政策鬆綁，積極回補土地庫存的動能有限。
paras_en: Commercial real estate firm CBRE Taiwan (formerly First Pacific Davis) reports that in Q3 2026, large‑scale commercial property deals (each over NT$3 billion) totaled NT$89.9 billion, bringing the cumulative total for the first three quarters to NT$257.7 billion – a historic high and up 109% year‑over‑year. By contrast, the land market, hampered by weak residential demand and cautious land‑buying by developers, saw its Q3 volume shrink to NT$22.9 billion and a cumulative NT$103.7 billion for the year, down 23%, highlighting a clear split between commercial and land markets.

Chairman Huang Rui‑nan of First Pacific Davis said the hardware investment momentum in the AI sector continues to generate huge business opportunities for Taiwan’s tech industry, extending from front‑end chip demand to data‑center and infrastructure construction, benefitting the entire supply chain. As the market moves into the peak Q4 season, strong expansion demand from the tech sector and proactive factory‑revitalisation by some traditional manufacturers are expected to push large‑scale commercial property transactions toward NT$300 billion for the full year, a leap‑forward growth and a new record.

The trend is driven by expanding AI application demand, robust export performance and strong corporate investment. The Directorate‑General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics raised its 2026 GDP growth forecast in August to 11.05%, the highest since 1988. Ongoing capacity expansion in the semiconductor and electronics sectors is heating up corporate‑owned factory demand, underpinning the surge in commercial real‑estate transactions.

First Pacific Davis listed the three biggest Q3 indicator deals: KGI Life’s NT$20.6 billion purchase of the entire Ruentex Yucheng Plaza from Ruentex (9945‑TW), Quanta Computer’s (2382‑TW) NT$19.7 billion acquisition of a Hua Ya Technology plant, and ASE Technology’s (3711‑TW) NT$6.3 billion purchase of a Kaohsiung Nankang Science Park factory. Although overall commercial‑property volumes hit a record, performance varies across product types in a K‑shaped pattern.

From January to August 2026, export orders rose 55% year‑over‑year, and the tech sector’s continued capital‑expenditure boost made factory transactions stand out. Q3 2026 factory‑deal volume reached NT$60.2 billion, accounting for nearly 70% of total commercial‑property transactions, and the cumulative Q1‑Q3 total hit NT$192 billion, almost three times last year’s figure. Expanding AI demand—from semiconductor manufacturing to data‑center and related infrastructure—is prompting supply‑chain players to accelerate capacity expansion, driving strong factory‑building needs.

The largest Q3 factory deal was Quanta Computer’s NT$19.7 billion purchase of a Hua Ya Technology Park plant for AI server production. Optics giant Largan Precision (2383‑TW) aggressively expanded in Taichung, buying seven parcels in Taichung Industrial Zone and the Taichung Precision Machinery Science Innovation Park between June and September for a total of NT$8 billion and about 17,000 ping of land. As major tech firms speed up expansion, land prices in Taichung’s industrial zone have risen roughly 10% over the past six months.

Regionally, the hottest factory‑deal zones in Q1‑Q3 2026 were Miaoli County and Taoyuan City, with transaction values of NT$69 billion and NT$54.9 billion respectively. Miaoli’s large‑scale factory availability and spill‑over effects from Hsinchu Science Park have turned it into a key hub; notable deals include Micron’s NT$52.8 billion Q1 transaction and further investments by Siliconware Precision Industries, Silicon Motion (3023‑TW) and others, each exceeding NT$2 billion.

Office‑space transactions ranked second in Q3, totaling NT$26.55 billion (about 30% of commercial‑property volume) and NT$46.38 billion for the first three quarters, indicating a rebound in acquisition activity. The biggest office deal was KGI Life’s NT$20.6 billion purchase of the entire Ruentex Yucheng Plaza, the largest office transaction on record, priced at roughly NT$1.125 million per ping. The seller used a sale‑and‑leaseback structure, and companies such as NVIDIA have already leased more than half of the space, with an estimated yield of 3%—above the insurance‑industry minimum of 2.72% for 2024.

Although the central bank kept rates unchanged in Q3, insurance‑industry regulations mean that if rates stay flat in Q4, the minimum yield requirement for insurers will rise to 2.895% next year; a 0.5‑point or 1‑point rate hike in Q4 would push the threshold to 2.92% or 2.945% respectively. This encourages insurers to lock in prime‑location, stable‑yield assets now, as higher yield thresholds next year will narrow investment opportunities.

In the land market, 2026 saw about a 20% drop in developer project launches, residential starts and pre‑sale volumes, with land‑deal volume continuing to shrink. Q3 land transactions amounted to NT$22.9 billion and NT$103.7 billion for the first three quarters, down 23% year‑over‑year. Cautious buying saw developers spend only NT$12.6 billion in the quarter and NT$53 billion for the year, a 40% decline, as they prioritize selling existing inventory over new acquisitions.

Despite the overall market softness, leading developers remain interested in large‑scale projects with economies of scale and strategic locations. The Kaohsiung‑based Kaiming Senior High School land deal was the biggest this quarter; Haiyue (2348‑TW), Xinmei Qi (2442‑TW) and Jiemeng Construction formed a consortium that, after acquiring part of the site in 2024, bought four additional parcels for NT$3.52 billion this quarter, bringing total investment to NT$9 billion over 3,923 ping, to be developed via urban renewal.

KunYue Development (5206‑TW) followed its previous‑quarter NT$1.12 billion acquisition of Taichung Phase‑7 land with a further NT$1.05 billion purchase of an adjacent block from a related party in Q3, raising its total holdings to 722 ping at roughly NT$3 million per ping, continuing to expand and consolidate its core Phase‑7 footprint.

The central bank recently announced a relaxation of credit controls to warm the housing market, raising the second‑home mortgage loan‑to‑value cap from 60% to 70% and removing the 18‑month construction‑start deadline for developers. The measures are expected to halt the decline in residential demand and spur a modest rebound, though developer land‑holding data show that 2024 purchases still topped NT$165.9 billion, indicating ample land inventory and limited short‑term incentive to replenish land stocks.

items.title: 新光人壽外價金申報連續出錯 遭金管會裁罰240萬元
items.title_en: Shin Kong Life Insurance Repeated Errors in Foreign Currency Reserve Reporting, Fined NT$2.4 Million by Financial Supervisory Commission
paras: 金管會今(24)日針對新光人壽辦理監理報表申報作業違規案進行裁處，新壽因未依規定逕自收回並減少外匯價格變動準備金(俗稱外價金)期初餘額、決策過程未落實法令遵循等內控機制，且於後續修正財報後仍以錯誤數據報送監理機關，違反《保險法》相關規定，遭金管會裁處新台幣 240 萬元罰鍰。
保險局指出，新光人壽向安定基金申報2026年1月份月報表中，將外價金期初餘額填報為560億元，較2025年12月底餘額1,035億元大幅減少475億元。經查，外價金屬保險法令明定之法定負債，依行為時「人身保險業外匯價格變動準備金應注意事項」規定，僅有提存及沖抵機制，並無逕為收回之規定。
保險局表示，新壽在未向法令遵循單位確認適法性的情況下，即逕自於監理報表中收回並減少外價金期初餘額，顯示其內部控制制度雖已建立，但未能有效發揮功能，已違反《保險業內部控制及稽核制度實施辦法》第5條第1項第8款規定。主管機關依《保險法》第171條之1第4項，就內控缺失部分開罰180萬元。
此外，新壽雖於2026年5月15日發布的第1季財報中將外價金餘額依法修正提列，惟其於5月20日向安定基金申報2026年4月份月報表時，竟仍沿用錯誤基礎之外價金數據，直到申報5月份月報表時才更正。
此舉已構成未依規定格式及內容彙報業務財務狀況，違反《保險法》第148條之1第2項規定，金管會再依同法第171條之1第1項裁罰60萬元。兩項違規事實合計處以240萬元罰鍰。
paras_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) issued a penalty today (the 24th) against Shin Kong Life Insurance for violations in its supervisory report filings. The insurer had unilaterally withdrawn and reduced the opening balance of its foreign‑exchange price‑change reserve (commonly called the foreign‑currency reserve) without following regulations, failed to implement legal‑compliance procedures in its decision‑making process, and continued to submit erroneous data to the regulator after correcting its financial statements, breaching the Insurance Act and incurring a fine of NT$2.4 million.

The Insurance Bureau noted that Shin Kong Life reported an opening foreign‑currency reserve balance of NT$56 billion in its January 2026 monthly report to the An‑ding Fund, a drop of NT$47.5 billion from the NT$103.5 billion balance at the end of December 2025. Investigation found that the foreign‑currency reserve is a statutory liability defined by the Insurance Act; under the “Guidelines for Foreign‑Exchange Price‑Change Reserves of Life Insurers,” only deposit and offset mechanisms are permitted, and there is no provision allowing unilateral withdrawal.

The bureau said that Shin Kong Life reduced the opening balance of the foreign‑currency reserve in its supervisory report without first obtaining confirmation of legality from its compliance unit, showing that although an internal control system existed, it was not functioning effectively. This violated Article 5‑1‑8 of the “Implementation Measures for Internal Control and Audit Systems of Insurance Companies.” The regulator imposed a NT$1.8 million fine under Article 171‑1‑4 of the Insurance Act for the internal‑control breach.

Moreover, although Shin Kong Life legally adjusted the foreign‑currency reserve balance in its Q1 2026 financial report released on May 15, it still used the incorrect reserve figure when filing the April 2026 monthly report to the An‑ding Fund on May 20, only correcting the error in the May 2026 filing.

The conduct constitutes a failure to report business financial conditions in the prescribed format and content, violating Article 148‑1‑2 of the Insurance Act. The FSC imposed an additional NT$600,000 penalty under Article 171‑1‑1 of the same law, bringing the total fines for the two violations to NT$2.4 million.

items.title: 日元再朝160邁進 匯市干預風險升溫
items.title_en: Yen Nears 160 Again, Forex Intervention Risk Rises
paras: 隨著日本假期結束，日元兌美元長達兩週的跌勢令匯率再度逼近 160 心理關卡，市場對日本政府發動外匯干預的戒心顯著增強。
儘管日本央行日前將政策利率升至 1.25%，但因總裁植田和男會後表態不如期待鷹派，加上美國聯準會可能維持緊縮政策，美日利差格局依然頑固，市場普遍對干預能否扭轉貶勢持審慎態度。

160關卡成試金石 多空角力加劇

澳洲聯邦銀行外匯策略師 Carol Kong 指出，若美債殖利率持續上升，且市場繼續測試日本捍衛日元的決心，美元兌日元可能很快突破 160 大關。她強調，考量到先前官方的匯率檢查(Rate Check)及美日協同干預先例，一旦快速衝破該門檻，當局出手干預的機率將大幅提高。
然而，澳洲國民銀行(NAB)外匯策略負責人 Ray Attrill 認為，雖然日元極可能再次探向 160，但「干預警戒感本身或將暫時阻礙其突破」。
Attrill 補充，日本單獨干預的效果通常較為短暫，市場很快會消化其影響，欲實現持續反轉，美國的參與至關重要。若日元重回 160，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)捍衛強勢日元的信念將面臨考驗，美方再次支援的前提可能取決於日本是否展現超越市場預期的升息決心。

基本面不利 單靠干預難治本

金融服務公司 Ebury 市場策略負責人 Matthew Ryan 強調，外匯干預僅是暫時抑壓賣壓的手段，若缺乏強有力的貨幣政策配合，日本當局很難壓制日元走貶。瑞銀資產管理(UBS Asset Management)全球主權與貨幣固定收益主管 Kevin Zhao 甚至表示，若政府干預引發日元短暫反彈，他將視為「逢高賣出日元」的時機。
Zhao 分析，驅動日元疲軟的基本面政策並未改變，日本首相高市早苗維持擴張性財政政策，在巨額國債下偏好低利率環境，且「安倍經濟學並不代表強勢日元」。此外，即使日本央行升息，若聯準會亦同步升息，美日利差便難以收窄，單靠升息無法維持日元強勢。
瑞銀集團策略師 Shahab Jalinoos 等人也在報告中指出，數據顯示投機客先前的日元空頭部位已完全消化，在套利交易環境持續有利且美日利差仍大的背景下，投資人重新建立日元賣壓部位的空間已經打開。
paras_en: As the Japanese holiday ends, the yen's two‑week slide against the dollar has brought the exchange rate close to the psychological 160 level again, heightening market wariness of a possible foreign‑exchange intervention by the Japanese government.

Even though the Bank of Japan recently raised its policy rate to 1.25%, the tone of Governor Kazuo Ueda after the meeting was less hawkish than expected, and with the U.S. Federal Reserve likely to maintain a tight stance, the US‑Japan rate‑differential remains stubborn, leading markets to take a cautious view on whether intervention can reverse the yen's decline.

The 160 threshold is a litmus test, intensifying the tug‑of‑war between bulls and bears. Australian Commonwealth Bank FX strategist Carol Kong notes that if U.S. Treasury yields keep rising and markets continue testing Japan's resolve to defend the yen, the USD/JPY pair could soon break the 160 barrier. She stresses that, given past official rate checks and US‑Japan coordinated‑intervention precedents, a rapid breach would greatly increase the odds of authorities stepping in.
However, NAB FX strategy head Ray Attrill believes that while the yen is very likely to test 160 again, “the very sense of intervention caution itself may temporarily impede its breakthrough.”

Attrill adds that solo Japanese intervention tends to be short‑lived, with markets quickly absorbing its effect; a sustained reversal would require U.S. participation. If the yen returns to 160, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s belief in a strong yen will be tested, and any renewed U.S. support may hinge on Japan showing rate‑hike resolve beyond market expectations.

Fundamentals are unfavorable, making intervention alone insufficient. Ebury market strategist Matthew Ryan stresses that FX intervention only temporarily suppresses selling pressure, and without strong monetary policy backing, Japanese authorities will struggle to curb yen depreciation. UBS Asset Management sovereign‑and‑currency fixed‑income head Kevin Zhao even says that a brief yen rally sparked by government action would be a “sell‑the‑rally” opportunity.

Zhao analyses that the fundamental policies driving yen weakness have not changed: Prime Minister Kishida maintains expansionary fiscal policy despite massive debt, favoring a low‑rate environment, and “Abenomics does not imply a strong yen.” Moreover, even if the BOJ hikes rates, a simultaneous Fed hike would keep the US‑Japan spread wide, so rate hikes alone cannot sustain yen strength.

UBS Group strategists including Shahab Jalinoos note that data show speculative short‑yen positions have been fully absorbed. With arbitrage conditions still favorable and the US‑Japan rate spread remaining large, investors now have room to rebuild yen‑selling pressure.

items.title: 〈台股盤後〉台積電熄火 長假前觀望量縮跌132點險守4萬8大關 周漲843點
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market After Hours: TSMC Falters, Pre‑Holiday Caution Shrinks Volume, Down 132 Points, Holds Near 48,000 Mark; Weekly Rise 843 Points
paras: 台股今 (24) 日開低震盪，在台積電、鴻海走弱下，盤中一度下跌逾 400 點，來到47757.42點，回測5日線，不過隨著聯發科、散熱、ABF載板、CCL族群撐盤下，跌幅逐漸收斂，站回48000點大關。終場收48024.6點，下跌132.69點。中秋連假前，市場觀望，成交量縮至7366.23億元。台股周線連二紅，全周上漲843.85點
電子權值股漲跌互現，台積電 (2330-TW) 下跌25 元、跌幅1%，收2475元；聯發科 (2454-TW) 上漲100 元、漲1.93%，收5285 元。台達電 (2308-TW) 漲約 0.7%；鴻海 (2317-TW) 跌逾 2%，廣達 (2382-TW) 跌約 1%，日月光投控 (3711-TW)  則小漲0.87%。
AI 伺服器功耗持續提高，水冷散熱滲透率及單機價值量同步提升，散熱族群表現亮眼，雙鴻 (3324-TW) 大漲逾 8%，健策 (3653-TW) 漲近 6%，奇鋐 (3017-TW) 漲逾 2%，建準 (2421-TW) 也漲約 2%。
景碩8月獲利獲利大幅成長，ABF 載板族群走強，景碩 (3189-TW) 漲近 6%，盤中一度逼近千元大關；欣興 (3037-TW) 漲約 1%，南電 (8046-TW)、臻鼎-KY (4958-TW) 維持小幅上漲。
CCL族群部分，聯茂(6213-TW)漲停，金居(8358-TW)漲約2%，台燿(6274-TW)漲約1%，台光電(2383-TW)於平盤震盪。
paras_en: Taiwan stocks opened lower and oscillated today (24th), weakening on TSMC and Foxconn, dropping over 400 points mid‑session to 47,757.42, testing the 5‑day moving average. However, with MediaTek, cooling, ABF substrate and CCL groups supporting, the decline narrowed and the index recovered to the 48,000 level. It closed at 48,024.6, down 132.69 points. Ahead of the Mid‑Autumn holiday, market caution reduced turnover to NT$7,366.23 billion. The weekly chart shows two consecutive red days, the index up 843.85 points for the week.

Electronic heavyweight stocks showed mixed moves: TSMC (2330‑TW) fell NT$25, down 1%, closing at NT$2,475; MediaTek (2454‑TW) rose NT$100, up 1.93%, closing at NT$5,285. Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) gained about 0.7%; Foxconn (2317‑TW) fell more than 2%; Quanta (2382‑TW) slipped about 1%; and ASE Technology Holding (3711‑TW) edged up 0.87%.

AI server power consumption continues to rise, boosting water‑cooling penetration and per‑unit value, so the cooling sector performed strongly: Double‑Hong (3324‑TW) surged over 8%, Jiancè (3653‑TW) rose nearly 6%, Qihong (3017‑TW) jumped over 2%, and Jianzhun (2421‑TW) also rose about 2%.

Jing Shuo's August profit grew sharply, and the ABF substrate group strengthened; Jing Shuo (3189‑TW) rose nearly 6%, briefly approaching the NT$1,000 mark during trading; Unimicron (3037‑TW) gained about 1%; Nan Dian (8046‑TW) and Zhen Ding‑KY (4958‑TW) maintained modest gains.
In the CCL group, Lianmao (6213‑TW) hit the daily limit up, Jinju (8358‑TW) rose about 2%, Tai Yao (6274‑TW) up about 1%, and Taiwan Optical (2383‑TW) traded flat.

items.title: 解析Meta Muse，預想應用場景與AI變現模式
paras: Meta Muse早期下載數據，討論意義其實不大

Meta 9/9推出全新人工智慧代理（AI Agent）工具「Muse」，兩週來迅速在美國應用程式排行榜取得亮眼成績。根據市場研調機構 Sensor Tower 數據，Muse 上線前 6 天即在美國蘋果 iOS 與 Google Play 免費榜榮登第 1 名，下載量突破 90.2 萬次，超越前代產品表現。並且在多項指標上超越了 ChatGPT 早期的行動版成績，這也是外資爭相調高META目標價，以及掀起9/21美股 CPU狂潮，本週主要利多催化劑:

針對於以上的數據與市場動向，筆者認為需要留意時空背景的不同，所謂早期數據的比較並非同一立足點，在ChatGPT時代，是一個普羅大眾幾乎完全不認識LLM、生成式AI的時期，憑空出世自然「早期成績」不會太好，ChatGPT的重點是劃時代的transformer架構與大規模應用。而Muse推出的現在，普羅大眾都知道AI，甚至是在燒錢補貼token的情況下濫用/亂用AI，所謂的免費版下載數與活躍人數，當然累積得很快，這是典型張飛打岳飛的情況。
真正的重點: Muse早期使用者反饋，及應用場景預想
Muse具備跨平台整合能力，透過瀏覽器連接 Gmail、Google 日曆、Notion、Opeantable或財務軟體等，結合外部第三方平台代為處理日常數位任務。並且除了獨立的Muse App，也深度整合至Meta旗下的 WhatsApp。
使用場景觀察早期使用者的分享，本中心推測Muse的優勢是便於商業化，產生類廣告與完成付費的最後一哩路。Ex:諮詢與跨平台比價過後，完成預訂商家/服務；另一個類似比價的是貸款利率，反覆打電話與話術砍價(利率)，美國用郵件與銀行往來交涉，有實測成功…
主要優勢關鍵與營運利多如下:
1.利用Meta社群之王的優勢，資料來源來自可調用數億使用者的社群內容(ex:非公開IG帳號)_
2.從過往廣告收入90%盈利佔比，擴增至訂閱以及交易收入分成，並向市場說明其AI變現
→整體來說，主要應用不脫離預約(餐廳/計程車、服務、課程)的日常生活行程安排，以及反覆且繁複比價。 更像是從一問一答，延伸到更完整的執行助理任務，至於反覆的觸發條件並執行單一任務，這類AI代理仍然應用場景偏少，更像是AI助理。
付費架構
競爭對手與供應鏈垂直整合比較
目前AI助理的主要競爭對手，只有SpaceX(xAI)的Grok bot。在此方面仍是藍海市場，這兩家廠商的模式較相同，可以理解
1.既有SNS app用戶數龐大，有特殊資料可以調閱
2.不像三大公有雲服務可以做AI退路(對比Google、Microsoft、AWS)
3大模型的追趕始終落後(對比OpenAI、Anthtopic)
4.缺乏成熟ASIC，AI成本相對大(對比Google、AWS)，遂轉往AI助理發展。
延伸討論與後續追蹤的議題是:

AI app的心占率，軟體之間的競爭反而是重點，Amazon先行ban掉Muse，可見端倪
另外，每每都是手機AI應用先行，這也側面證明了高精度、廣泛應用產景的終極應用，在現代社會很難落實，真正的AI代理，技術入門與硬體建置(個人工作站)等門檻都太高了，寧願降規與簡化，這個取捨也是AI發展之中，特別可以持續追蹤的方向，也代表邊緣AI與落地應用並沒有想像中這麼快、這麼美好。

items.title: 8萬美元投出亞洲首富 王瓊投資張一鳴報酬率逾15000倍
items.title_en: US$80,000 Invested the Asian Richest: Wang Qiong’s Investment in Zhang Yiming Yields Over 15,000‑fold Return
paras: 近期，張一鳴以 1,050 億美元的身價登頂亞洲首富。其實，在此背後，在 26 歲之前，他換了 4 份工作，創業失敗了 3 次。如果沒有一位伯樂當年的孤注一擲，他可能還在創業路上磕磕絆絆。
據報導，創業初期，張一鳴尋求資金的過程相當艱辛，曾走訪北京朝陽圈拜訪數十位創投業者均遭拒絕。當時紅杉資本經大量調研後選擇放棄，有知名創投合夥人僅交談15分鐘即離去，並向中間人指其風格不符合預期。在此背景下，時任SIG(海納亞洲)投資代表的王瓊選擇提供資金與資源支援。
兩人的合作始於2007年的酷訊網，當時24歲的張一鳴擔任技術委員會主席，在董事會會議中簡報技術架構與市場判斷。王瓊在受訪時對此回顧表示：「他的核心底氣是一致的，有時看似劣勢，實際上是優勢。」
2009年酷訊剝離房產業務後，王瓊邀請張一鳴帶領成立「九九房」，該公司在一年內即做到房產行動端第一。
2012年初，張一鳴在北京一家咖啡館中，於餐巾紙上畫出推薦引擎原型，提出「用演算法讓資訊主動找人」的構想。王瓊隨即代表SIG參與投資，於2012年3月字節跳動成立時注入8萬美元天使輪資金。
然而，字節跳動早期融資並不順利。金沙江創投合夥人朱嘯虎曾於受訪時提及，當時僅面談15分鐘即放棄投資，主因是個人對創業者風格的偏好；市場普遍質疑資訊市場已被傳統門戶網站佔據，技術能否帶來突破。
面對市場質疑與2012年底的資金緊縮，SIG追加了100萬美元A+輪投資與100萬美元過橋貸款助其渡過難關。王瓊自述在B輪融資期間扮演張一鳴的「樹洞」，每月通話30餘次聆聽其復盤並調整溝通策略，最終於2013年促成DST與奇虎360參與B輪投資。
對於堅持投資的原因，王瓊直言，她看重的並非演算法分發，而是張一鳴個人。截至2012年底，SIG累計投入600萬美元，持股比例達到12%。該筆投資的帳面報酬率如今超過15,000倍，刷新全球創投收益紀錄。
今天，張一鳴站在亞洲之巔，所有人都驚嘆於他擁有多少財富。但許多報導認為，在這一路上，他可能最應該感謝的是當年願意孤注一擲的王瓊。
paras_en: Recently, Zhang Yiming topped the list of Asia’s richest with a net worth of $105 billion. In fact, behind that, before turning 26 he changed jobs four times and failed at three startups. If not for a patron who took a gamble on him back then, he might still be stumbling on the entrepreneurial road.

According to reports, in the early days of his venture, Zhang’s search for funding was extremely difficult; he visited dozens of venture capitalists in Beijing’s Chaoyang circle and was rejected each time. At that time, Sequoia Capital, after extensive research, chose to walk away; a well‑known VC partner talked with him for only 15 minutes before leaving, telling the intermediary that his style didn’t match expectations. Against this backdrop, Wang Qiong, then a representative of SIG (Haina Asia), decided to provide capital and resource support.

The two began collaborating in 2007 with KuXun.com, when the 24‑year‑old Zhang served as chairman of the technical committee and presented the technology architecture and market judgment at a board meeting. Wang recalled in an interview, “His core confidence is consistent; what sometimes looks like a disadvantage is actually an advantage.”
After KuXun spun off its real‑estate business in 2009, Wang invited Zhang to lead the founding of “99 House”, which became the number‑one mobile real‑estate platform within a year.

In early 2012, Zhang sketched a prototype of a recommendation engine on a napkin in a Beijing café, proposing the idea of “using algorithms to let information find people proactively.” Wang immediately, on behalf of SIG, participated in the investment, injecting $80,000 in an angel round when ByteDance was founded in March 2012.

However, ByteDance’s early financing was not smooth. Zhu Xiaohu, a partner at GSR Ventures, later said in an interview that he walked away after a 15‑minute meeting, mainly because of personal preference for the founder’s style; the market generally doubted that the information market was already dominated by traditional portal sites and questioned whether technology could deliver a breakthrough.

Facing market skepticism and a cash crunch at the end of 2012, SIG added a $1 million Series A+ investment and a $1 million bridge loan to help it get through the difficulty. Wang said that during the Series B round she acted as Zhang’s “sound‑board,” speaking with him more than 30 times a month to review and adjust communication strategies, ultimately facilitating DST and Qihoo 360’s participation in the B‑round in 2013.

When asked why she persisted, Wang bluntly said she valued not the algorithmic distribution but Zhang himself. By the end of 2012, SIG had invested a total of $6 million, holding a 12 % stake. The paper return on that investment now exceeds 15,000‑fold, setting a new global VC‑return record.

Today, Zhang stands at the summit of Asia, and everyone marvels at his wealth. Yet many reports suggest that along the way, the person he should thank most is Wang Qiong, who was willing to bet everything on him back then.

items.title: 劍指華為昇騰！阿里發表真武V900 效能翻3倍、號稱中國最強晶片
items.title_en: Targeting Huawei Ascend! Alibaba Unveils Zhenwu V900, Performance Triples, Claims China's Strongest Chip
paras: 阿里巴巴(09988-HK) 在2026年雲棲大會發表新一代AI加速器真武V900，宣稱是「中國最強大的AI晶片」。
執行長吳泳銘表示，V900效能為上一代M890的3倍，將支援未來5兆至10兆參數等級的Qwen模型訓練。華為上週才公布新一代昇騰晶片，兩家公司在中國AI算力市場的競爭隨之升溫。
真武V900同時瞄準AI模型訓練與推理，配備216GB顯存、片間頻寬達1200GB/s；相較之下，上一代M890分別為144GB與800GB/s。
阿里巴巴表示，V900可擴展至最多50萬張卡組成的叢集；旗下晶片部門平頭哥則稱，超過1000顆V900可組成單一系統。M890先前支援的超節點規模為128卡。
不過，阿里巴巴尚未公布V900的FLOPS算力、製程節點、代工廠、功耗及記憶體頻寬，外界目前難以直接驗證「最強大」及「三倍效能」的說法。
作為比較，華為規劃於2027年第三季推出的昇騰960PR，預計配備192GB記憶體、2.4TB/s記憶體頻寬，以及2.2TB/s的擴展互連頻寬。兩款晶片的實際競爭力，仍有待產品交付後觀察。
阿里巴巴計畫於2027年第一季量產並商業發布V900，較今年5月路線圖所列的2027年第三季提前。截至今年5月，平頭哥已向逾400家外部客戶交付超過56萬顆真武系列晶片，目前客戶數增至逾650家；真武系列預計維持每年更新的節奏。
晶片之外，阿里巴巴也揭露模型進度：Qwen 4正在訓練，Qwen 4.5與Qwen 5已列入路線圖。
公司表示，Qwen3.8-Max在一個月的自動化運行中完成33個迭代週期，Artificial Analysis評分由40升至45；另一項晶片設計實驗則在逾60小時內調用EDA工具超過1萬次，使面積縮減42%，且未犧牲效能。
阿里巴巴設定2032年資料中心容量超過20吉瓦的目標，但吳泳銘坦言，全球AI供應鏈短缺正限制算力基礎設施的擴張速度，公司預期國內需求將帶動AI晶片出貨成長。
隨著華為先前因產能限制擱置昇騰晶片的全球推廣計畫，阿里巴巴能否如期量產V900，將是其擴大供應的關鍵。
paras_en: Alibaba (09988-HK) unveiled its next‑generation AI accelerator, the Zhenwu V900, at the 2026 Cloud Habitat Conference, claiming it is "China's most powerful AI chip."

CEO Wu Yongming said the V900 delivers three times the performance of the previous‑generation M890 and will support future Qwen models with 5‑to‑10‑trillion‑parameter scales. Huawei announced its new Ascend chip last week, intensifying the rivalry between the two firms in China's AI compute market.
The Zhenwu V900 is designed for both AI model training and inference, equipped with 216 GB of memory and an inter‑chip bandwidth of 1,200 GB/s, compared with the M890's 144 GB and 800 GB/s.

Alibaba said the V900 can scale to clusters of up to 500,000 cards; its chip division, Pingtouge, added that more than 1,000 V900s can be combined into a single system. The M890 previously supported a maximum of 128 cards.

However, Alibaba has not disclosed the V900's FLOPS, manufacturing process node, foundry, power consumption, or memory bandwidth, making it difficult for outsiders to verify the "most powerful" and "three‑fold performance" claims.

For comparison, Huawei plans to launch the Ascend 960PR in Q3 2027, which is expected to feature 192 GB of memory, 2.4 TB/s memory bandwidth, and 2.2 TB/s of expansion interconnect bandwidth. The actual competitiveness of the two chips will only become clear after product deliveries.

Alibaba aims to mass‑produce and commercially launch the V900 in Q1 2027, a full quarter earlier than the Q3 2027 timeline listed in its May roadmap. As of May this year, Pingtouge had delivered over 560,000 Zhenwu‑series chips to more than 400 external customers, and the customer base has now grown to over 650; the Zhenwu series is expected to continue its annual refresh cadence.
Beyond the chip, Alibaba also disclosed its model roadmap: Qwen 4 is currently in training, while Qwen 4.5 and Qwen 5 are already on the roadmap.

The company reported that Qwen 3.8‑Max completed 33 iteration cycles in one month of automated runs, raising its Artificial Analysis score from 40 to 45. Another chip‑design experiment invoked EDA tools over 10,000 times in more than 60 hours, shrinking area by 42% without sacrificing performance.

Alibaba has set a target of exceeding 20 GW of data‑center capacity by 2032, but Wu Yongming admitted that global AI supply‑chain shortages are limiting the pace of compute‑infrastructure expansion, and the firm expects domestic demand to drive AI‑chip shipments higher.
With Huawei previously shelving its global rollout of Ascend chips due to capacity constraints, whether Alibaba can meet its V900 mass‑production schedule will be pivotal for expanding its supply.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉中鋼看好鋼市供需結構好轉 鋼鐵族群抗跌彰源飆漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: China Steel optimistic about steel market supply‑demand improvement; steel sector resists decline, Chang Yuan soars to limit‑up
paras: 中鋼(2002-TW)昨日法說會釋出鋼市供需結構好轉、基本面維持穩定展望，激勵鋼鐵族群今(24)日逆勢抗跌，彰源(2030-TW)漲停板、新鋼(2032-TW)漲8%，允強(2034-TW)、千興(2025-TW)等也漲逾半根停版。
中鋼表示，目前鋼市正面因素包括各國科技等基建及國防支出增加，需求將逐步復甦、印度等新興市場加速成長，中國持續推行減產政策，搭配產能置換措施，收斂超額供給；另外，冶金煤供應緊俏，煉鋼成本仍維持高檔。
中鋼表示，雖然地緣政治風險，以及成本是否影響復甦進程仍需審慎觀察，但整體而言基本面維持穩定、鋼市供需結構好轉；中鋼10月盤價全面調漲、第四季盤價也開出平高盤，
中鋼指出，國際鋼價有回升跡象，有助於帶動下游客戶補庫契機，其中，美國市場因國內現貨供應持續緊張、需求強勁，價格來到四年新高，加上鋼廠秋季維修停產，第四季價格仍可能進一步上行，部分鋼廠已無現貨可供應，買方可能增加進口因應。
paras_en: China Steel (2002‑TW) yesterday at its earnings conference disclosed that the steel market supply‑demand structure is improving and fundamentals remain stable, prompting the steel sector today (24th) to resist a broader decline; Chang Yuan (2030‑TW) hit the limit‑up, Xin Steel (2032‑TW) rose 8%, and Yun Qiang (2034‑TW), Qian Xing (2025‑TW) and others also rose more than half a limit‑up board.

China Steel said that current positive factors for the steel market include increased technology‑related infrastructure and defense spending in various countries, leading to a gradual recovery in demand, accelerated growth in emerging markets such as India, and China’s continued implementation of production‑cut policies combined with capacity‑replacement measures that are tightening excess supply; moreover, metallurgical coal supplies are tight, keeping steel‑making costs at a high level.

China Steel noted that although geopolitical risks and whether costs will affect the recovery process still require careful monitoring, overall fundamentals remain stable and the steel market supply‑demand structure is improving; China Steel raised its October spot prices across the board and also set a higher‑than‑average price for the fourth quarter.

China Steel pointed out that international steel prices show signs of rebounding, which could help trigger downstream customers to restock; in particular, the U.S. market, where domestic spot supply remains tight and demand is strong, has seen prices reach a four‑year high. Combined with steel‑plant autumn maintenance shutdowns, fourth‑quarter prices may rise further, and some mills have run out of spot inventory, prompting buyers to increase imports.

items.title: 〈房產〉AI供應鏈擴廠熱絡 商仲：全年商用不動產交易向上挑戰3000億元
items.title_en: <Real Estate> AI Supply Chain Expansion Fuels Hot Market; Commercial Real Estate Transactions Could Challenge NT$3 Trillion This Year
paras: 商仲第一太平戴維斯統計指出，2026年第三季大型商用不動產(單筆交易3億元以上)交易金額達899億元，累計1-3季達2,577億元，創下歷史新高，比去年同期大增109%。相較之下，土地市場受住宅買氣疲弱與開發商購地趨於審慎影響，交易規模持續收斂，第三季交易金額僅229億元，累計1-3季為1,037億元，年減23%，商用不動產與土地市場明顯分化。

第一太平戴維斯董事長黃瑞楠表示，AI產業的硬體投資動能持續為台灣科技業帶來龐大商機，並已由前端晶片需求進一步延伸至資料中心與基礎設施建置，帶動相關產業鏈同步受惠。接下來邁入第四季交易旺季，於經濟產業K型分化下，科技業擴產需求強勁，部分傳產業者藉由這股利多積極活化廠房，並希望在年底前完成交易，供給與需求同步增溫下，預期全年大型商用不動產交易金額有機會挑戰3,000億元，呈現跳躍式成長，並寫下歷史新高。
此一走勢主要受惠於AI應用需求持續擴大，台灣出口與企業投資動能維持強勁，主計總處於8月再度上修2026年經濟成長率預測至11.05%，創下1988年以來新高。在半導體及電子產業持續擴充產能帶動下，企業自用廠房需求升溫，支撐商用不動產市場交易動能創下新高。
第一太平戴維斯指出，第三季前三大指標交易包含凱基人壽以206億元向潤泰新(9945-TW)購買潤泰玉成廣場整棟商辦、廣達電腦(2382-TW)以197億購置華亞科廠房和日月光(3711-TW)以63億購置南科高雄園區廠房，儘管商用不動產交易金額寫下歷史新高，不同產品類型的表現呈K型發展的現象。
而2026年1-8月外銷訂單金額年增55%，科技業持續擴大資本支出，推升廠房交易表現一枝獨秀。2026年第三季廠房交易金額達602億元，占第三季商用不動產交易比重近70%，累計1-3季達1,920億元，較去年同期成長近3倍。隨著AI應用需求持續擴大，從半導體製造到資料中心及相關基礎設施建置，均帶動供應鏈業者加速擴產布局，展現更積極的擴廠需求。
2026年第三季最大廠房交易為電腦及周邊設備製造業的廣達電腦斥資197億元購入華亞科技園區廠房，作為AI伺服器產線布局；光學器材製造業大廠大立光(2383-TW)積極在台中擴產，自6月至9月間陸續購入7筆台中工業區及台中精密機械科技創新園區廠房，累計交易金額達80億元，合計取得近1.7萬坪的土地。隨著科技大廠加速擴廠，台中工業區內觀察到明顯漲幅，帶動區內土地單價近半年上漲約1成。
進一步觀察廠房交易區域，2026年1-3季交易熱區為苗栗縣及桃園市，交易金額分別達690億元及549億元。其中，苗栗縣因具備大面積廠房取得條件，同時受惠於新竹科學園區產業外溢效應，罕見躍居全台廠房交易重鎮，除第一季美光高達528億元的指標交易案帶動外，包括矽品、信邦(3023-TW)等科技業者亦持續於當地布局，且單一交易規模都超過20億元，苗栗縣逐漸成為科技業布局的重要區域。
2026年第三季辦公室交易排名第二，交易金額達265.5億元，占商用不動產交易約30%，累計1-3季達463.8億元，購置動能回升。最大貢獻來自凱基人壽以206億元購入潤泰玉成廣場整棟大樓，創下歷年來最大筆的辦公室交易案，拆算建物單價約每坪112.5萬元。賣方採售後回租模式，且目前已有輝達等知名科技企業承租逾半棟辦公空間，預估投報率可達3%，符合今年保險業不動產最低投報率2.72%的門檻。
雖然第三季央行利率維持不變，依照保險業相關規範，即使第四季利率不變，明年保險業投報率門檻將提高至2.895%；若第四季升息半碼或1碼，門檻將分別升至2.92%及2.945%之間。這也促使保險業在投報率提升前，提前布局於精華地區及具收益穩定的不動產，預期明年投報率提升後，投資機會將更有限。
同時，土地市場交易方面，2026年建商推案、住宅開工戶數及預售屋成交量皆減少約20%，土地交易規模也持續萎縮。第三季土地交易金額為229億元，累計前三季交易金額為1,037億元，較去年同期減少23%。受住宅市場低迷影響，建商購地態度審慎，本季僅投入126億元，累計1-3季購地金額為530億元，年減40%，開發商短期內仍以去化餘屋為優先考量。
儘管整體市場偏弱，指標建商對於具規模效益及區位優勢的大型開發案仍維持布局意願。其中，開明高職土地案為本季最大交易，海悅(2348-TW)、新美齊(2442-TW)與濟盟建設組成合作聯盟，於2024年取得部分土地後，本季再以35.2億元購入4筆土地進行整合，累計投資金額達90億元、總面積達3,923坪，未來將以都市更新模式推動開發。
坤悅開發(5206-TW)則繼上一季以11.2億元取得台中七期土地後，2026年第三季再以10.5億元向關係人購入同街廓基地，累計取得土地面積達722坪，土地單價皆達每坪300萬元，持續擴大並整合七期核心區布局。
台灣央行日前宣布放寬信用管制，為房市注入暖流，放寬項目包括將第二戶房貸成數上限由6成提高至7成，並取消建商18個月開工期限相關規定，預期新規定將使住宅買氣止跌回升，但觀察近五年建商購地金額，2024年仍高達1,659億元，這也隱含建商土地庫存還算充足，短期內因政策鬆綁，積極回補土地庫存的動能有限。
paras_en: Commercial real estate firm CBRE Taiwan (formerly First Pacific Davis) reports that in Q3 2026, large‑scale commercial property deals (each over NT$3 billion) totaled NT$89.9 billion, bringing the cumulative total for the first three quarters to NT$257.7 billion – a historic high and up 109% year‑over‑year. By contrast, the land market, hampered by weak residential demand and cautious land‑buying by developers, saw its Q3 volume shrink to NT$22.9 billion and a cumulative NT$103.7 billion for the year, down 23%, highlighting a clear split between commercial and land markets.

Chairman Huang Rui‑nan of First Pacific Davis said the hardware investment momentum in the AI sector continues to generate huge business opportunities for Taiwan’s tech industry, extending from front‑end chip demand to data‑center and infrastructure construction, benefitting the entire supply chain. As the market moves into the peak Q4 season, strong expansion demand from the tech sector and proactive factory‑revitalisation by some traditional manufacturers are expected to push large‑scale commercial property transactions toward NT$300 billion for the full year, a leap‑forward growth and a new record.

The trend is driven by expanding AI application demand, robust export performance and strong corporate investment. The Directorate‑General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics raised its 2026 GDP growth forecast in August to 11.05%, the highest since 1988. Ongoing capacity expansion in the semiconductor and electronics sectors is heating up corporate‑owned factory demand, underpinning the surge in commercial real‑estate transactions.

First Pacific Davis listed the three biggest Q3 indicator deals: KGI Life’s NT$20.6 billion purchase of the entire Ruentex Yucheng Plaza from Ruentex (9945‑TW), Quanta Computer’s (2382‑TW) NT$19.7 billion acquisition of a Hua Ya Technology plant, and ASE Technology’s (3711‑TW) NT$6.3 billion purchase of a Kaohsiung Nankang Science Park factory. Although overall commercial‑property volumes hit a record, performance varies across product types in a K‑shaped pattern.

From January to August 2026, export orders rose 55% year‑over‑year, and the tech sector’s continued capital‑expenditure boost made factory transactions stand out. Q3 2026 factory‑deal volume reached NT$60.2 billion, accounting for nearly 70% of total commercial‑property transactions, and the cumulative Q1‑Q3 total hit NT$192 billion, almost three times last year’s figure. Expanding AI demand—from semiconductor manufacturing to data‑center and related infrastructure—is prompting supply‑chain players to accelerate capacity expansion, driving strong factory‑building needs.

The largest Q3 factory deal was Quanta Computer’s NT$19.7 billion purchase of a Hua Ya Technology Park plant for AI server production. Optics giant Largan Precision (2383‑TW) aggressively expanded in Taichung, buying seven parcels in Taichung Industrial Zone and the Taichung Precision Machinery Science Innovation Park between June and September for a total of NT$8 billion and about 17,000 ping of land. As major tech firms speed up expansion, land prices in Taichung’s industrial zone have risen roughly 10% over the past six months.

Regionally, the hottest factory‑deal zones in Q1‑Q3 2026 were Miaoli County and Taoyuan City, with transaction values of NT$69 billion and NT$54.9 billion respectively. Miaoli’s large‑scale factory availability and spill‑over effects from Hsinchu Science Park have turned it into a key hub; notable deals include Micron’s NT$52.8 billion Q1 transaction and further investments by Siliconware Precision Industries, Silicon Motion (3023‑TW) and others, each exceeding NT$2 billion.

Office‑space transactions ranked second in Q3, totaling NT$26.55 billion (about 30% of commercial‑property volume) and NT$46.38 billion for the first three quarters, indicating a rebound in acquisition activity. The biggest office deal was KGI Life’s NT$20.6 billion purchase of the entire Ruentex Yucheng Plaza, the largest office transaction on record, priced at roughly NT$1.125 million per ping. The seller used a sale‑and‑leaseback structure, and companies such as NVIDIA have already leased more than half of the space, with an estimated yield of 3%—above the insurance‑industry minimum of 2.72% for 2024.

Although the central bank kept rates unchanged in Q3, insurance‑industry regulations mean that if rates stay flat in Q4, the minimum yield requirement for insurers will rise to 2.895% next year; a 0.5‑point or 1‑point rate hike in Q4 would push the threshold to 2.92% or 2.945% respectively. This encourages insurers to lock in prime‑location, stable‑yield assets now, as higher yield thresholds next year will narrow investment opportunities.

In the land market, 2026 saw about a 20% drop in developer project launches, residential starts and pre‑sale volumes, with land‑deal volume continuing to shrink. Q3 land transactions amounted to NT$22.9 billion and NT$103.7 billion for the first three quarters, down 23% year‑over‑year. Cautious buying saw developers spend only NT$12.6 billion in the quarter and NT$53 billion for the year, a 40% decline, as they prioritize selling existing inventory over new acquisitions.

Despite the overall market softness, leading developers remain interested in large‑scale projects with economies of scale and strategic locations. The Kaohsiung‑based Kaiming Senior High School land deal was the biggest this quarter; Haiyue (2348‑TW), Xinmei Qi (2442‑TW) and Jiemeng Construction formed a consortium that, after acquiring part of the site in 2024, bought four additional parcels for NT$3.52 billion this quarter, bringing total investment to NT$9 billion over 3,923 ping, to be developed via urban renewal.

KunYue Development (5206‑TW) followed its previous‑quarter NT$1.12 billion acquisition of Taichung Phase‑7 land with a further NT$1.05 billion purchase of an adjacent block from a related party in Q3, raising its total holdings to 722 ping at roughly NT$3 million per ping, continuing to expand and consolidate its core Phase‑7 footprint.

The central bank recently announced a relaxation of credit controls to warm the housing market, raising the second‑home mortgage loan‑to‑value cap from 60% to 70% and removing the 18‑month construction‑start deadline for developers. The measures are expected to halt the decline in residential demand and spur a modest rebound, though developer land‑holding data show that 2024 purchases still topped NT$165.9 billion, indicating ample land inventory and limited short‑term incentive to replenish land stocks.

items.title: 新光人壽外價金申報連續出錯 遭金管會裁罰240萬元
items.title_en: Shin Kong Life Insurance Repeated Errors in Foreign Currency Reserve Reporting, Fined NT$2.4 Million by Financial Supervisory Commission
paras: 金管會今(24)日針對新光人壽辦理監理報表申報作業違規案進行裁處，新壽因未依規定逕自收回並減少外匯價格變動準備金(俗稱外價金)期初餘額、決策過程未落實法令遵循等內控機制，且於後續修正財報後仍以錯誤數據報送監理機關，違反《保險法》相關規定，遭金管會裁處新台幣 240 萬元罰鍰。
保險局指出，新光人壽向安定基金申報2026年1月份月報表中，將外價金期初餘額填報為560億元，較2025年12月底餘額1,035億元大幅減少475億元。經查，外價金屬保險法令明定之法定負債，依行為時「人身保險業外匯價格變動準備金應注意事項」規定，僅有提存及沖抵機制，並無逕為收回之規定。
保險局表示，新壽在未向法令遵循單位確認適法性的情況下，即逕自於監理報表中收回並減少外價金期初餘額，顯示其內部控制制度雖已建立，但未能有效發揮功能，已違反《保險業內部控制及稽核制度實施辦法》第5條第1項第8款規定。主管機關依《保險法》第171條之1第4項，就內控缺失部分開罰180萬元。
此外，新壽雖於2026年5月15日發布的第1季財報中將外價金餘額依法修正提列，惟其於5月20日向安定基金申報2026年4月份月報表時，竟仍沿用錯誤基礎之外價金數據，直到申報5月份月報表時才更正。
此舉已構成未依規定格式及內容彙報業務財務狀況，違反《保險法》第148條之1第2項規定，金管會再依同法第171條之1第1項裁罰60萬元。兩項違規事實合計處以240萬元罰鍰。
paras_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) issued a penalty today (the 24th) against Shin Kong Life Insurance for violations in its supervisory report filings. The insurer had unilaterally withdrawn and reduced the opening balance of its foreign‑exchange price‑change reserve (commonly called the foreign‑currency reserve) without following regulations, failed to implement legal‑compliance procedures in its decision‑making process, and continued to submit erroneous data to the regulator after correcting its financial statements, breaching the Insurance Act and incurring a fine of NT$2.4 million.

The Insurance Bureau noted that Shin Kong Life reported an opening foreign‑currency reserve balance of NT$56 billion in its January 2026 monthly report to the An‑ding Fund, a drop of NT$47.5 billion from the NT$103.5 billion balance at the end of December 2025. Investigation found that the foreign‑currency reserve is a statutory liability defined by the Insurance Act; under the “Guidelines for Foreign‑Exchange Price‑Change Reserves of Life Insurers,” only deposit and offset mechanisms are permitted, and there is no provision allowing unilateral withdrawal.

The bureau said that Shin Kong Life reduced the opening balance of the foreign‑currency reserve in its supervisory report without first obtaining confirmation of legality from its compliance unit, showing that although an internal control system existed, it was not functioning effectively. This violated Article 5‑1‑8 of the “Implementation Measures for Internal Control and Audit Systems of Insurance Companies.” The regulator imposed a NT$1.8 million fine under Article 171‑1‑4 of the Insurance Act for the internal‑control breach.

Moreover, although Shin Kong Life legally adjusted the foreign‑currency reserve balance in its Q1 2026 financial report released on May 15, it still used the incorrect reserve figure when filing the April 2026 monthly report to the An‑ding Fund on May 20, only correcting the error in the May 2026 filing.

The conduct constitutes a failure to report business financial conditions in the prescribed format and content, violating Article 148‑1‑2 of the Insurance Act. The FSC imposed an additional NT$600,000 penalty under Article 171‑1‑1 of the same law, bringing the total fines for the two violations to NT$2.4 million.

items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market After Hours: TSMC Falters, Pre‑Holiday Caution Shrinks Volume, Down 132 Points, Holds Near 48,000 Mark; Weekly Rise 843 Points
paras: 台股今 (24) 日開低震盪，在台積電、鴻海走弱下，盤中一度下跌逾 400 點，來到47757.42點，回測5日線，不過隨著聯發科、散熱、ABF載板、CCL族群撐盤下，跌幅逐漸收斂，站回48000點大關。終場收48024.6點，下跌132.69點。中秋連假前，市場觀望，成交量縮至7366.23億元。台股周線連二紅，全周上漲843.85點
電子權值股漲跌互現，台積電 (2330-TW) 下跌25 元、跌幅1%，收2475元；聯發科 (2454-TW) 上漲100 元、漲1.93%，收5285 元。台達電 (2308-TW) 漲約 0.7%；鴻海 (2317-TW) 跌逾 2%，廣達 (2382-TW) 跌約 1%，日月光投控 (3711-TW)  則小漲0.87%。

items.title: 解析Meta Muse，預想應用場景與AI變現模式
paras: Meta Muse早期下載數據，討論意義其實不大

Meta 9/9推出全新人工智慧代理（AI Agent）工具「Muse」，兩週來迅速在美國應用程式排行榜取得亮眼成績。根據市場研調機構 Sensor Tower 數據，Muse 上線前 6 天即在美國蘋果 iOS 與 Google Play 免費榜榮登第 1 名，下載量突破 90.2 萬次，超越前代產品表現。並且在多項指標上超越了 ChatGPT 早期的行動版成績，這也是外資爭相調高META目標價，以及掀起9/21美股 CPU狂潮，本週主要利多催化劑:

針對於以上的數據與市場動向，筆者認為需要留意時空背景的不同，所謂早期數據的比較並非同一立足點，在ChatGPT時代，是一個普羅大眾幾乎完全不認識LLM、生成式AI的時期，憑空出世自然「早期成績」不會太好，ChatGPT的重點是劃時代的transformer架構與大規模應用。而Muse推出的現在，普羅大眾都知道AI，甚至是在燒錢補貼token的情況下濫用/亂用AI，所謂的免費版下載數與活躍人數，當然累積得很快，這是典型張飛打岳飛的情況。
真正的重點: Muse早期使用者反饋，及應用場景預想
Muse具備跨平台整合能力，透過瀏覽器連接 Gmail、Google 日曆、Notion、Opeantable或財務軟體等，結合外部第三方平台代為處理日常數位任務。並且除了獨立的Muse App，也深度整合至Meta旗下的 WhatsApp。
使用場景觀察早期使用者的分享，本中心推測Muse的優勢是便於商業化，產生類廣告與完成付費的最後一哩路。Ex:諮詢與跨平台比價過後，完成預訂商家/服務；另一個類似比價的是貸款利率，反覆打電話與話術砍價(利率)，美國用郵件與銀行往來交涉，有實測成功…
主要優勢關鍵與營運利多如下:
1.利用Meta社群之王的優勢，資料來源來自可調用數億使用者的社群內容(ex:非公開IG帳號)_
2.從過往廣告收入90%盈利佔比，擴增至訂閱以及交易收入分成，並向市場說明其AI變現
→整體來說，主要應用不脫離預約(餐廳/計程車、服務、課程)的日常生活行程安排，以及反覆且繁複比價。 更像是從一問一答，延伸到更完整的執行助理任務，至於反覆的觸發條件並執行單一任務，這類AI代理仍然應用場景偏少，更像是AI助理。
付費架構
競爭對手與供應鏈垂直整合比較
目前AI助理的主要競爭對手，只有SpaceX(xAI)的Grok bot。在此方面仍是藍海市場，這兩家廠商的模式較相同，可以理解
1.既有SNS app用戶數龐大，有特殊資料可以調閱
2.不像三大公有雲服務可以做AI退路(對比Google、Microsoft、AWS)
3大模型的追趕始終落後(對比OpenAI、Anthtopic)
4.缺乏成熟ASIC，AI成本相對大(對比Google、AWS)，遂轉往AI助理發展。
延伸討論與後續追蹤的議題是:

AI app的心占率，軟體之間的競爭反而是重點，Amazon先行ban掉Muse，可見端倪
另外，每每都是手機AI應用先行，這也側面證明了高精度、廣泛應用產景的終極應用，在現代社會很難落實，真正的AI代理，技術入門與硬體建置(個人工作站)等門檻都太高了，寧願降規與簡化，這個取捨也是AI發展之中，特別可以持續追蹤的方向，也代表邊緣AI與落地應用並沒有想像中這麼快、這麼美好。

items.title: 〈焦點股〉中鋼看好鋼市供需結構好轉 鋼鐵族群抗跌彰源飆漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: China Steel optimistic about steel market supply‑demand improvement; steel sector resists decline, Chang Yuan soars to limit‑up
paras: 中鋼(2002-TW)昨日法說會釋出鋼市供需結構好轉、基本面維持穩定展望，激勵鋼鐵族群今(24)日逆勢抗跌，彰源(2030-TW)漲停板、新鋼(2032-TW)漲8%，允強(2034-TW)、千興(2025-TW)等也漲逾半根停版。
中鋼表示，目前鋼市正面因素包括各國科技等基建及國防支出增加，需求將逐步復甦、印度等新興市場加速成長，中國持續推行減產政策，搭配產能置換措施，收斂超額供給；另外，冶金煤供應緊俏，煉鋼成本仍維持高檔。
中鋼表示，雖然地緣政治風險，以及成本是否影響復甦進程仍需審慎觀察，但整體而言基本面維持穩定、鋼市供需結構好轉；中鋼10月盤價全面調漲、第四季盤價也開出平高盤，
中鋼指出，國際鋼價有回升跡象，有助於帶動下游客戶補庫契機，其中，美國市場因國內現貨供應持續緊張、需求強勁，價格來到四年新高，加上鋼廠秋季維修停產，第四季價格仍可能進一步上行，部分鋼廠已無現貨可供應，買方可能增加進口因應。
paras_en: China Steel (2002‑TW) yesterday at its earnings conference disclosed that the steel market supply‑demand structure is improving and fundamentals remain stable, prompting the steel sector today (24th) to resist a broader decline; Chang Yuan (2030‑TW) hit the limit‑up, Xin Steel (2032‑TW) rose 8%, and Yun Qiang (2034‑TW), Qian Xing (2025‑TW) and others also rose more than half a limit‑up board.

China Steel said that current positive factors for the steel market include increased technology‑related infrastructure and defense spending in various countries, leading to a gradual recovery in demand, accelerated growth in emerging markets such as India, and China’s continued implementation of production‑cut policies combined with capacity‑replacement measures that are tightening excess supply; moreover, metallurgical coal supplies are tight, keeping steel‑making costs at a high level.

China Steel noted that although geopolitical risks and whether costs will affect the recovery process still require careful monitoring, overall fundamentals remain stable and the steel market supply‑demand structure is improving; China Steel raised its October spot prices across the board and also set a higher‑than‑average price for the fourth quarter.

China Steel pointed out that international steel prices show signs of rebounding, which could help trigger downstream customers to restock; in particular, the U.S. market, where domestic spot supply remains tight and demand is strong, has seen prices reach a four‑year high. Combined with steel‑plant autumn maintenance shutdowns, fourth‑quarter prices may rise further, and some mills have run out of spot inventory, prompting buyers to increase imports.

items.title: 晶技(3042)AI石英振盪器ASP隨光模組升級3.2T產品估逼近7美元
items.title_en: AcSiP (3042) AI Quartz Oscillator ASP Rises with Photonic Module Upgrade; 3.2T Product Near $7
paras: 2026年09月24日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI資料中心傳輸速度持續升級，除了帶動高速光模組需求，也開始提高關鍵頻率元件的單顆價值。晶技(3042-TW)表示，隨光模組由800G朝1.6T、3.2T演進，石英振盪器對高頻率、低抖動及低相位雜訊的要求同步提高，其中800G相關產品平均售價(ASP)約1.5美元，1.6T提高至約2至2.5美元，3.2T則可能逼近7美元。
石英振盪器是任何電子設備的「時鐘」，主要功能是提供穩定的頻率訊號，讓晶片與不同元件按照精準的時間節奏運作。資料傳輸速度愈快，系統對時脈訊號的精準度與穩定性要求也愈高，因此高速光模組需要規格更高的石英振盪器。
晶技指出，AI資料中心運算能力提高後，資料傳輸頻寬也必須同步增加，光模組從800G進入1.6T後，相關IC、迴路與元件規格更加嚴格。除了工作頻率提高，低抖動、相位雜訊等指標也成為高速傳輸的限制條件，使石英振盪器規格跟著升級。
規格提高也直接反映在產品價格。以晶技提供的價格區間來看，800G石英振盪器ASP約1.5美元，1.6T約2至2.5美元，到了3.2T可能接近7美元，相較800G提高至4倍以上。不過公司表示，不同產品的料號、規格及出貨量均有差異，實際ASP仍須依產品組合而定。
目前800G朝1.6T升級仍處於起步階段。晶技表示，1.6T需求正逐步增加，更下一代3.2T已有多項產品進入打樣、送樣及客戶測試階段，目前仍屬產品驗證過程，尚未進入大量出貨。
晶技目前在光模組相關石英振盪器市場市占率約20%以上。公司表示，市場主要約有四至五家供應商，各家市占率約落在20%至40%不等，晶技目前並非最大供應商，相關市占率仍有提升空間。
AI業務占比也持續增加。晶技預估，AI應用占營收比重將由2025年的11%提高至2026年的16%；車用則由26%提高至28%，成為最大應用市場，手機占比則降至24%。公司並預期，AI與車用兩大業務後續占整體營收比重將超過50%，營運結構逐步由手機與消費電子轉向AI基礎建設與汽車電子。
因應高階產品需求，晶技2026年資本支出規畫約新台幣10.78億元，其中平鎮廠預計投入約6億至7億元，擴充高精準、高穩定度、低抖動及低相位雜訊產品所需的前段製程。公司透露，目前約80%的資本支出與AI應用相關產品有關。
產品組合改變也開始反映在毛利率。晶技第2季毛利率由第1季32.3%提高至33.11%，7月進一步升至36%。公司表示，毛利率提高主要來自AI與車載等較高毛利產品占比增加，並非產品全面漲價。

paras_en: September 24, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – As AI data‑center transmission speeds keep climbing, demand for high‑speed photonic modules surges and the per‑unit value of key frequency components also rises. AcSiP (3042‑TW) says that as photonic modules evolve from 800G to 1.6T and 3.2T, quartz oscillators face higher requirements for frequency, low jitter and low phase noise. The average selling price (ASP) of 800G‑related products is about $1.5, 1.6T climbs to roughly $2‑2.5, and 3.2T could approach $7.

Quartz oscillators are the “clock” of any electronic device, providing a stable frequency signal so chips and components operate in precise timing. The faster the data transmission, the higher the system’s demand for clock accuracy and stability, so high‑speed photonic modules need quartz oscillators with tighter specifications.

AcSiP notes that as AI data‑center computing power grows, bandwidth must increase accordingly. When photonic modules move from 800G to 1.6T, the associated ICs, loops and component specs become stricter. In addition to higher operating frequencies, low jitter and phase‑noise metrics become limiting factors for high‑speed transmission, prompting upgrades to quartz oscillator specifications.

The spec upgrades directly translate into higher product prices. According to AcSiP’s price ranges, the ASP for 800G quartz oscillators is about $1.5, for 1.6T about $2‑2.5, and for 3.2T possibly close to $7 – more than four times the 800G level. However, the company cautions that part numbers, specs and shipment volumes differ across products, so actual ASP depends on the product mix.

The shift from 800G to 1.6T is still in its early stage. AcSiP says demand for 1.6T is gradually rising, and several 3.2T products have already entered sampling, delivery and customer testing phases. These are still in verification and have not yet reached mass production.

AcSiP currently holds a market share of about 20% or more in the quartz oscillator market for photonic modules. The market comprises roughly four to five suppliers, each with a share ranging from 20% to 40%. AcSiP is not the largest supplier, leaving room for share growth.

AI business share continues to rise. AcSiP forecasts AI‑related revenue to grow from 11% in 2025 to 16% in 2026; automotive from 26% to 28%, becoming the largest application market, while mobile drops to 24%. The company expects AI and automotive to together exceed 50% of total revenue, shifting the operating structure from mobile and consumer electronics toward AI infrastructure and automotive electronics.

To meet high‑end product demand, AcSiP plans 2026 capital expenditures of about NT$1.078 billion, with the Pingzhen plant slated for NT$600‑700 million to expand front‑end processes needed for ultra‑precise, highly stable, low‑jitter and low‑phase‑noise products. The firm reveals that roughly 80% of its capex is tied to AI‑related applications.

The product mix shift is already reflected in gross margins. AcSiP’s Q2 gross margin rose from 32.3% in Q1 to 33.11%, and further to 36% in July. The company says the margin improvement stems from a higher proportion of higher‑margin AI and automotive products, not from across‑the‑board price hikes.

items.title: 〈房產〉婚育家庭額度增 青安3.0平均每戶金額創新高平均達930.9萬元
items.title_en: [Real Estate] Increased Limits for Married and Child‑bearing Families; Qing'an 3.0 Average per Household Reaches Record High of NT$9.309 million
paras: 官方在2026年 8月上路的青安3.0第一張成績單出爐，開辦首月共受理4605戶，雖然較7月增約17.6%，但仍比青安2.0平均每月約5000戶的申辦量略低；首月的撥貸戶數則僅有175戶，平均每戶撥貸金額來到930.9萬元，較青安2.0時期增加超過百萬元，每戶平均背債金額改寫青安系列貸款新高。
台灣房屋趨勢中心執行長張旭嵐表示，青安3.0設有申貸人年所得低於200萬元、年齡未滿50歲的排富及排老條款，對於購屋總價也因地制宜設定上限，總體而言，申貸資格比青安2.0嚴苛，加上目前房市景氣仍處於盤整階段，使青安3.0上路首月的表現，無法與青安2.0初期引發的熱潮等量齊觀。
青安3.0首月4605筆受理案件中，兩年內新婚與育兒家庭有近千戶，占比超過2成，平均每戶的申貸金額超過1100萬元，至於其餘一般戶不到700萬元。張旭嵐分析，因青安3.0婚育家庭加碼，額度上限最高可達1500萬元，使青安3.0的人均申貸金額遠高於青安2.0，且隨著獎助婚育的政策目標持續發酵，預估未來青安3.0的人均撥貸金額，突破1000萬元大關的機會頗高。
進一步觀察青安3.0的撥貸情形，8月整體戶數不到200戶，其中一般戶撥貸102戶，新婚家庭撥貸11戶，育兒家庭則撥貸62戶。整體撥貸情形與7月超過5000戶相比大幅縮水。
台灣房屋集團趨勢中心資深經理陳定中表示，7月因屬青安2.0的最終月份，許多過去申貸未撥的案件須「清倉」結案，加上部分買家搶搭青安2.0末班車，使得7月撥貸戶數衝上近期高水位。而8月是青安3.0的首月，一般貸款流程從送件、估價到撥款，通常需耗時半個月以上，尤其青安3.0限制較多，須審核申貸人的身分、所得、年齡、婚育等條件，貸前甄審的程序繁雜，作業時間也會因而延長，因此能趕在8月當月撥款的案件稀少。
此外，現今房貸授信在信用管制下仍相對緊縮，且年底新案交屋與企業融資需求都較高，銀行端常會保留額度因應大宗借款，所以即使消費者符合青安3.0的申辦資格，行庫放貸心態依然保守，整體排撥時間也略有拉長，不少行庫已需排隊到明年，建議有意申貸的消費者，需謹慎規劃申貸時程，並須預留資金以防貸款額度不如預期。
paras_en: The first report card for Qing'an 3.0, released in August 2026, shows that in its launch month 4,605 applications were processed – up about 17.6% from July but still slightly below the average monthly volume of roughly 5,000 applications under Qing'an 2.0. Only 175 loans were disbursed in the first month, with an average loan amount of NT$9.309 million per household, more than NT$1 million higher than during the Qing'an 2.0 period, setting a new high for the series of loans.

Zhang Xulan, CEO of the Taiwan Housing Trend Center, explained that Qing'an 3.0 includes “wealth‑screening” and “age‑screening” clauses that exclude applicants with an annual income above NT$2 million or age 50 and over, and sets price caps that vary by location. Overall, the eligibility criteria are stricter than Qing'an 2.0, and because the housing market remains in a consolidation phase, the first‑month performance of Qing'an 3.0 cannot match the initial frenzy generated by Qing'an 2.0.

Among the 4,605 applications in the first month of Qing'an 3.0, nearly a thousand were from newly‑married or child‑raising families, accounting for over 20% of the total, with an average loan amount exceeding NT$11 million per household. The remaining “regular” households averaged under NT$7 million. Zhang noted that the program’s higher ceiling – up to NT$15 million for married‑and‑child families – pushes the per‑household loan amount far above that of Qing'an 2.0, and as the policy goal of encouraging marriage and child‑rearing continues to take effect, the likelihood of the average disbursement surpassing the NT$10 million mark is high.

Looking more closely at disbursements for Qing'an 3.0, fewer than 200 households received loans in August: 102 regular households, 11 newly‑married households and 62 child‑rearing households. This represents a sharp contraction compared with more than 5,000 households disbursed in July.

Chen Dingzhong, senior manager at the Taiwan Housing Group Trend Center, said July was the final month of Qing'an 2.0, so many pending applications had to be “cleared out,” and some buyers rushed to take the last‑minute Qing'an 2.0 loans, pushing July’s disbursement numbers to a recent peak. In August, the first month of Qing'an 3.0, the loan process—from submission and appraisal to funding—typically takes more than half a month, especially given the many restrictions that require verification of income, age, marital and child status, making pre‑loan screening complex and extending processing times, so few cases could be funded within August itself.

Furthermore, mortgage credit remains relatively tight under credit controls, and with high demand for year‑end new‑home deliveries and corporate financing, banks often reserve capacity for large‑scale borrowing. Consequently, even qualified applicants may face conservative lending attitudes and slightly longer allocation times, with many banks already queuing cases into next year. Prospective borrowers are advised to plan their application timeline carefully and set aside funds in case the approved loan amount falls short of expectations.

items.title: 坐5望6？5年期美債殖利率衝破5%、10年站上5.1%　華爾街共識：股市「崩盤線」上移
items.title_en: Aiming for 5, Expecting 6? 5‑Year U.S. Treasury Yield Breaks 5%, 10‑Year Tops 5.1% – Wall Street Consensus Shifts Stock‑Market “Crash Line” Higher
paras: 美債遭遇新一輪猛烈拋售，5年期殖利率周三(23日)飆升近20個基點，自2007年來首破5%，2年期飆升近15個基點，突破4.9%，續創2024年底以來新高，10年期殖利率飆破5.1%，創近19年新高，但5%這一曾經被視為風險資產「減速帶」的警戒線，此次並未立刻引爆全球股市劇烈回調，反而凸顯出當前市場韌性與分歧並存的複雜格局。
華爾街對利率風險的研判正出現微妙分化。BlueBay市場策略主管Mike Bell指出，市場不存在絕對觸發拋售的「魔法點位」，關鍵在於殖利率與股票獲利回報之間的相對溢價。當無風險殖利率持續走高而企業獲利未見顯著擴張，股市風險補償被極限壓縮，資產配置天平才會真正傾斜，這意味著單一數值突破並不必然導致系統性崩跌，結構性對比才是核心。
股市展現超預期抗跌性，與經濟結構深層變化密切相關。摩根大通(下稱小摩)分析指出，隨著AI、先進製造與高端服務業權重上升，大量高景氣企業即便面對昂貴融資成本，仍有充沛現金流維繫資本擴張，削弱傳統貨幣政策的收緊傳導。
小摩近期與大型機構溝通後發現，投資者普遍認為迫使股市全面重估的「破壞閾值」已從5%被動上移至5.5%至6%區間，顯示市場對高利率的容忍度正在提升。
但5%以上的資本成本絕非可長期無視。景順全球資產配置主管Paul Jackson表示，美債作為全球定價錨，突破5%後對追求確定性資金具極強吸引力。根據景順的歷史量化模型，當10年債殖利率過去12個月移動均值攀升至4.72%上方，全球股市將受實質壓制。目前，該均值約4.34%，距離拐點仍有一定緩衝，但Jackson已開始縮減股票部位並加碼主權債券，展現出防禦性佈局。
聯準會(Fed)官員古爾斯比示警，殖利率短期觸及5%與長期停留5%以上完全不同，時間一長，債務滾動壓力終將侵蝕企業預算與資本開支。
Premier Miton投資長Neil Birrell分析指出，當前股市平靜源於多數機構獲利模型尚未完全計入「長期5%以上」的折現率，真正的考驗將發生在全市場集中重跑模型、下修遠期現金流假設之時。
在29兆美元美債市場主導的重新定價中，邊際壓力已在防線薄弱處暴露。數據顯示，伴隨美債殖利率走強吸引資本回流美元資產，新興市場債券與股票基金近期出現規模達數十億美元的明顯流出，主權債務海外發行節奏亦大幅降溫。對高負債與依賴外幣融資的市場而言，資本成本跳升的苦果正以更快速度兌現，全球金融市場的結構性分化或將進一步加劇。
paras_en: U.S. Treasuries faced a fresh wave of heavy selling, with the 5‑year yield surging almost 20 basis points on Wednesday (the 23rd) to break 5% for the first time since 2007. The 2‑year rose nearly 15 basis points, topping 4.9% and setting a new high since the end of 2024, while the 10‑year yield jumped past 5.1%, a near‑19‑year peak. Yet the 5% warning line, once seen as a “slow‑down zone” for risk assets, did not immediately trigger a sharp global equity correction; instead it highlighted a complex landscape where market resilience coexists with divergent views.

Wall Street’s assessment of rate risk is showing subtle divergence. BlueBay’s head of market strategy, Mike Bell, notes that there is no absolute “magic level” that automatically triggers a sell‑off; the key is the relative premium between yields and equity earnings returns. When risk‑free yields keep climbing while corporate profits do not expand markedly, equity risk compensation is squeezed to the limit and the asset‑allocation balance truly tips. This means a single number crossing a threshold does not necessarily cause a systemic crash—structural comparisons are what matter.

Equities have shown better‑than‑expected resistance, closely tied to deep structural shifts in the economy. JPMorgan (referred to as “JPM”) analysis points out that as AI, advanced manufacturing and high‑end services gain weight, many high‑growth companies can sustain capital expansion despite expensive financing, thanks to abundant cash flow, which weakens the transmission of traditional monetary tightening.

JPM recently found, after talks with large institutions, that investors generally believe the “break‑point” that would force a full equity re‑rating has moved passively from 5% to a 5.5%‑6% range, indicating rising tolerance for higher rates.

However, capital costs above 5% cannot be ignored indefinitely. Invesco’s global asset‑allocation head Paul Jackson says U.S. Treasuries serve as a global pricing anchor, and once yields break 5% they become extremely attractive to funds seeking certainty. According to Invesco’s historical quantitative model, when the 12‑month moving average of the 10‑year yield climbs above 4.72%, global equities face real pressure. The current average is about 4.34%, leaving some buffer before the inflection point, but Jackson has already begun trimming equity exposure and adding sovereign bonds, reflecting a defensive stance.

Fed official Christopher Waller warned that a short‑term yield touch of 5% is very different from a sustained level above 5%; over time, the debt‑rollover pressure will erode corporate budgets and capital spending.

Premier Miton’s chief investment officer Neil Birrell argues that today’s market calm stems from most institutions not yet fully incorporating a “long‑term >5%” discount rate into their profit models. The real test will come when the whole market has to re‑run models and downgrade forward cash‑flow assumptions.

In the $29 trillion U.S. Treasury‑dominated repricing, marginal pressure is already showing at weak points. Data show that as Treasury yields rise and attract capital back to dollar assets, emerging‑market bonds and equity funds have recently seen outflows of tens of billions of dollars, and sovereign‑debt issuance abroad has slowed sharply. For markets with high debt and reliance on foreign‑currency financing, the pain of rising capital costs is materialising faster, and structural divergence in global financial markets may intensify further.

items.title: 美債殖利率飆升會怎樣？房貸、車貸與企業融資變貴 股市也承壓
items.title_en: What Happens When US Treasury Yields Surge? Mortgages, Auto Loans and Corporate Financing Get Costlier, Stock Market Under Pressure
paras: 美國公債殖利率週三 (23 日) 急升，10 年期美債殖利率盤中觸及 5.125%，來到全球金融危機前的水準。這波漲勢若持續，影響將從債市傳至房貸、車貸與企業融資，推高借款成本，並可能壓抑消費與投資。當天美股下跌，利率敏感類股首當其衝。
債市賣壓來自多項因素。美國 9 月製造業採購經理人調查結果高於預期，顯示工業活動升溫；油價上漲，加深市場對通膨的憂慮。同日標售的 5 年期美債需求疲弱，也促使投資人賣出債券、推升殖利率。
聯準會 (Fed) 的利率前景同樣牽動債市。Fed 理事巴爾 (Michael Barr) 週三表示，為使通膨回到 2% 目標，仍須進一步升息。
分析指出，截至報導時，市場預估 Fed 10 月升息 1 碼的機率接近 70%，高於一週前的 48%，以及一個月前的不到 10%。
10 年期美債殖利率週三觸及 5.125%，創 2007 年以來最高。對 Fed 利率預期較敏感的 2 年期美債殖利率上升超過 13 個基點，突破 4.9%。債券價格與殖利率走勢相反，這波急升也使持有美債及其他債券的投資人面臨價格下跌。
對一般家庭而言，最直接的變化是借錢更貴。
10 年期美債殖利率是房貸等長期借款利率的重要參考。根據 Mortgage News Daily，美國 30 年期房貸利率已達 7.26%，過去幾週上升逾 0.25 個百分點，較一年前則高出近 1 個百分點。房貸成本繼續上升，可能進一步壓抑部分地區已顯疲弱的房市。
車貸、信用卡及其他消費信貸也面臨壓力。Fed 上週升息 1 碼後，作為浮動利率信貸參考的基本利率升至 7%。美國家庭負債總額接近 19 兆美元，消費支出又占經濟活動將近七成，借貸成本提高可能逐步削弱民眾支出意願。
安聯貿易北美資深經濟學家 Dan North 以汽車市場為例指出，貸款變貴會讓部分消費者更難買車；購車需求下降，接著可能減少汽車業對勞工的需求，使經濟放緩。
North 也認為，存款戶雖可望取得稍高利息，但一般儲蓄帳戶利率目前約為 0.37%，增加的收益難以抵銷家庭在住房及其他貸款上承受的壓力。
企業同樣難以置身事外。
美債殖利率上升的影響已擴及公司債與房貸證券市場；North 指出，借款能力較弱的中小企業，尤其容易受到信貸取得難度增加的影響。
銀行可能因放款利率提高及存放款利差擴大而受惠，但若企業與家庭減少借貸，貸款需求也會受到壓抑。
金融市場與美股大盤已先反映利率壓力。週三標普 500 指數下跌約 0.8%，那斯達克指數跌約 1.1%，道瓊跌約 0.7%；公用事業、房地產及非必需消費類股表現較弱。
除了借款成本上升可能拖累經濟，債券殖利率竄高，進一步提高債券吸引力，也使資金可能由股市轉向債市。
Bryn Mawr Trust 投資策略主管 Andrew Davis 指出，這波債市賣壓反映市場同時面對經濟活動轉強與通膨壓力上升：成長較強，使經濟有能力承受較高利率；通膨持續，則限縮 Fed 降低利率的空間。對債市而言，兩股力量同時出現，使投資人必須重新評估高利率會維持多久。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury yields spiked sharply on Wednesday (the 23rd), with the 10‑year yield hitting 5.125% intraday – a level not seen since before the global financial crisis. If the rally continues, the impact will flow from the bond market into mortgages, auto loans and corporate financing, raising borrowing costs and potentially dampening consumption and investment. U.S. equities fell that day, with rate‑sensitive sectors hit first.

The sell‑off in bonds was driven by several factors. A September U.S. manufacturing PMI came in above expectations, signalling hotter industrial activity; higher oil prices deepened inflation worries. On the same day, weak demand for 5‑year Treasuries at auction also prompted investors to sell bonds, pushing yields higher.
The Fed’s rate outlook also tugged at the bond market. Fed Governor Michael Barr said on Wednesday that further rate hikes are needed to bring inflation back to the 2% target.
Analysts noted that, at the time of reporting, the market’s probability of a one‑point Fed hike in October was close to 70%, up from 48% a week earlier and less than 10% a month earlier.

The 10‑year Treasury yield reached 5.125% on Wednesday, the highest since 2007. The two‑year yield, which is more sensitive to Fed expectations, rose more than 13 basis points, breaking above 4.9%. Because bond prices move opposite to yields, the sharp rise also means holders of Treasuries and other bonds are seeing price declines.
For ordinary households, the most immediate change is that borrowing becomes more expensive.

The 10‑year Treasury yield is a key benchmark for long‑term loan rates such as mortgages. According to Mortgage News Daily, the U.S. 30‑year mortgage rate has climbed to 7.26%, up more than 0.25 percentage points over the past few weeks and nearly 1 point higher than a year ago. Rising mortgage costs could further suppress a housing market that is already showing signs of weakness in some regions.

Auto loans, credit cards and other consumer credit are also feeling the pressure. After the Fed’s one‑point hike last week, the benchmark rate that underlies variable‑rate credit rose to 7%. U.S. household debt is close to $19 trillion, and consumer spending accounts for roughly 70% of economic activity, so higher borrowing costs could gradually erode willingness to spend.

Allianz Trade North America senior economist Dan North used the auto market as an example, noting that more expensive financing will make it harder for some consumers to buy cars; weaker car demand could then reduce labor needs in the automotive sector, slowing the economy.

North also pointed out that while depositors may earn slightly higher interest, the average savings‑account rate is only about 0.37% right now, so the extra yield is unlikely to offset the pressure families face from higher housing and other loan costs.
Companies are similarly unable to stay out of the fallout.

The rise in Treasury yields has already spilled over into corporate bonds and mortgage‑backed securities; North said that smaller firms with weaker credit profiles are especially vulnerable as access to financing becomes more difficult.
Banks may benefit from higher loan rates and wider net interest margins, but if businesses and households cut back on borrowing, loan demand will also be suppressed.

Financial markets and the broad U.S. equity index have already priced in rate pressure. On Wednesday the S&P 500 fell about 0.8%, the Nasdaq dropped roughly 1.1% and the Dow slid about 0.7%; utilities, real estate and discretionary stocks lagged behind.
Beyond higher borrowing costs potentially dragging on the economy, soaring bond yields make bonds more attractive, which could shift capital away from equities toward fixed income.

Bryn Mawr Trust investment‑strategy head Andrew Davis said the current bond‑market sell‑off reflects a market confronting both stronger economic activity and rising inflation: robust growth gives the economy capacity to bear higher rates, while persistent inflation limits the Fed’s room to cut rates. With those two forces at play, investors must reassess how long elevated rates are likely to persist.

items.title: 美國期中選舉倒數一個多月 科技股可能面臨麻煩？
items.title_en: U.S. Midterm Election Less Than a Month Away: Could Tech Stocks Face Trouble?
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，距離美國期中選舉只剩一個多月，而這場選舉可能對近期漲勢強勁的AI類股，以及其他幾個產業造成影響。
花旗(Citi)在周二晚間發布的一份研究報告中提出了對即將到來選舉的預測。該行表示，如果民主黨拿下眾議院與參議院，並不會感到意外。
花旗美國股票策略師Scott Chronert表示，無論選舉結果如何，期中選舉很可能對標普500指數的基本面「不會造成太大影響」，但如果民主黨在兩院都取得控制權，可能會影響數個產業。
他表示，在這種情況下，保險、醫療保健設備與製藥類股可能表現相對良好，原因是市場預期民主黨將恢復先前失去的部分醫療保健保障。
Chronert補充指出，晶片投資人「偏好共和黨控制局面，可能與AI立法風險有關」，但他也指出，總統川普仍有權否決國會議員試圖推動的任何AI監管措施。
部分民主黨政治人物在期中選舉前已提出加強AI監管的主張。川普則拒絕放慢這項技術發展的呼籲，並表示美國有必要以比中國更快的速度推進AI發展。
通膨、經濟，以及伊朗戰爭，也是選民正在權衡的議題。
目前的市場預測顯示，共和黨可能難以維持眾議院或參議院其中任何一院的控制權。截至周三，預測平台Polymarket的交易價格反映出民主黨同時拿下參眾兩院的機率約為66%。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reports that the U.S. midterm election is just over a month away, and this election could affect AI stocks that have been rallying strongly recently, as well as several other industries.

Citi released a research report on Tuesday evening that offered forecasts for the upcoming election. The bank said it would not be surprised if the Democrats win control of both the House and the Senate.

Citi U.S. equity strategist Scott Chronert said that regardless of the election outcome, the midterms are unlikely to have a major impact on the fundamentals of the S&P 500, but if Democrats control both chambers, several sectors could be affected.

He noted that in that scenario, insurance, medical‑device and pharmaceutical stocks could perform relatively well, as the market expects Democrats to restore some of the healthcare coverage that was previously lost.

Chronert added that chip investors “prefer a Republican‑controlled environment, possibly due to AI‑legislation risk,” but he also pointed out that President Trump still has the authority to veto any AI regulatory measures that Congress members try to push.

Some Democratic politicians have already called for tighter AI regulation ahead of the midterms. Trump, however, rejected calls to slow the technology’s development and said the United States needs to advance AI faster than China.
Inflation, the economy, and the war in Iran are also issues voters are weighing.

Current market odds show that Republicans may find it difficult to retain control of either the House or the Senate. As of Wednesday, the prediction platform Polymarket’s trading prices reflected a roughly 66% probability that Democrats will win both chambers.

items.title: 煙草業迎監管轉向！川普政府擬放寬審查 加速電子煙審批 尼古丁袋也受惠
items.title_en: Tobacco Industry Faces Regulatory Shift! Trump Administration Plans to Ease Review, Speed Up E‑Cigarette Approvals, Nicotine Pouches Also Set to Benefit
paras: 川普政府正準備調整美國電子煙與尼古丁袋的監管審批制度, 可能透過修改現行審查規則、簡化部分科學研究要求及縮短審查時間, 加快更多無燃燒尼古丁產品進入合法市場。華爾街日報引述知情人士報導,FDA預計最快未來幾天宣布相關措施, 但具體方案仍可能調整。
這項計畫的核心之一, 是重新檢視2021年制定的新菸草產品上市申請要求。知情人士表示,FDA可能增加審查彈性, 包括簡化企業提交的科學研究要求, 同時加快產品審查速度, 讓更多電子煙及尼古丁袋產品有機會取得上市許可。
目前美國法律要求新菸草產品上市前必須經過FDA審查, 機構需評估產品上市是否符合保護整體公共健康的標準, 包括產品對現有使用者與非使用者帶來的風險及可能利益。FDA的審查資料顯示, 相關申請數量龐大, 部分產品的審查時間已遠超過法定期限。
業者長期抱怨FDA審查進度過慢。路透社9月初報導, 煙草商Altria Group(MO-US)已對FDA提起訴訟, 要求機構改革新菸草產品審查制度。Altria指出, 美國法律要求FDA在收到申請後180天內作出決定, 但該公司表示,FDA從未達到這項期限, 部分產品申請甚至已經延宕多年。
Altria在訴訟中表示, 其On!尼古丁袋產品受到監管程序拖延影響, 同時未經FDA授權的外國競爭產品持續在美國市場取得市占。該公司與其他原告要求法院撤銷現行制度, 並要求FDA建立新的審查機制。FDA當時未立即回應置評要求。
這項監管變化可能對大型煙草企業的新型尼古丁產品布局產生直接影響。除了Altria之外, Philip Morris International(PM-US)及British American Tobacco(BTI-US)同樣持續將資源轉向電子煙、加熱式菸草及尼古丁袋等無燃燒產品, 因此若FDA縮短審查時間, 企業推出新產品及擴大合法產品組合的速度可能加快。
FDA近幾個月已經開始加速部分產品的審查。8月21日,FDA透過尼古丁袋試點計畫, 批准由Swedish Match USA生產的11款ZYN ULTRA尼古丁袋上市。FDA表示, 這11款產品包括Chill、Citrus、Cool Mint、Deep Freeze、Menthol、Peppermint、Smooth、Spearmint及Wintergreen等口味, 濃度涵蓋9毫克及11毫克。
FDA表示, 截至8月21日, 該機構累計已批准43款尼古丁袋產品, 其中23款是在尼古丁袋試點計畫下取得批准。FDA指出, 試點計畫透過改善審查流程, 加快處理問題、縮短申請人回覆缺失通知所需時間, 並提高科學審查效率, 機構已開始把相關經驗應用到其他新菸草產品申請。
8月28日,FDA又批准JUUL Labs的JUUL2電子煙系統上市, 包括電子煙裝置以及菸草口味和薄荷口味兩款煙彈, 合計3項產品。FDA目前公布的上市核准紀錄也顯示, 這是2026年一系列電子煙及尼古丁產品審查決定的一部分。
川普政府此次可能推動的制度調整, 也與非法電子煙市場快速擴張有關。支持改革的人士認為, 如果合法市場能提供更多經過FDA審查的口味與產品, 可能有助於消費者從未經授權的產品轉向合法供應來源。政府方面則表示, 政策目標包括防止尼古丁落入兒童手中、打擊街頭販售的仿冒電子煙, 同時為希望戒除傳統香菸的成年人提供被政府視為較安全的替代選項。

不過, 政策方向也引發公共衛生團體及兩黨部分國會議員反對。批評者擔心, 如果FDA降低或簡化部分證據要求, 尤其是放寬水果及甜味等口味電子煙的上市門檻, 可能提高青少年接觸及使用尼古丁產品的風險。曾參與制定2021年規則的FDA前菸草產品中心主任Mitch Zeller表示, 他對近期針對調味菸草產品的政策方向持懷疑態度, 認為非法調味電子煙問題應透過執法處理, 而非降低產品取得上市許可的證據門檻。
部分國會議員也已對FDA近期核准更多調味產品表達疑慮。共和黨籍緬因州參議員Susan Collins在本月一場聽證會上表示, 藍莓及芒果等口味可能讓電子煙對年輕人更具吸引力。相關爭議預料也可能成為川普提名的FDA局長人選Heidi Overton在9月24日參議院確認聽證會上的焦點之一。
此次政策方向也與川普第一任期形成對比。當時FDA曾推動將水果等調味電子煙撤出零售通路, 主要理由是抑制青少年電子煙使用, 並警告甜味口味可能吸引大量兒童接觸尼古丁。如今第二任期的監管方向則更加強調建立合法產品供應, 加快部分新型尼古丁產品進入市場。
FDA今年5月也發布另一項指引, 允許部分已提交上市申請、但尚未完成完整科學審查的菸草產品在特定條件下繼續銷售, FDA並表示將依相關政策決定執法優先順序。公共衛生團體已對這項政策提出法律挑戰, 認為FDA改變監管方式時未依法提供充分的公眾參與程序。
對煙草業而言, 若FDA最終採取更快的審查機制, 可能降低新產品等待審批期間的成本及市場延遲, 同時讓企業更快擴充無燃燒產品組合。但政策能否真正縮短審查時間, 哪些科學研究要求會被修改, 以及調味電子煙與尼古丁袋產品的核准標準是否改變, 仍須等待FDA正式公布方案才能確定。
整體而言, 川普政府此次可能推動的改革, 是在FDA既有尼古丁產品審查制度與日益龐大的申請積壓之間尋求新的監管模式。FDA近期已透過尼古丁袋試點計畫及JUUL2核准展現加速審查的跡象, 若進一步修改2021年規則, 未來電子煙及尼古丁袋的產品上市速度可能明顯改變。不過, 如何在加快合法產品供應、打擊非法市場與避免青少年使用增加之間取得平衡, 仍將是這項政策面臨的主要爭議。
paras_en: The Trump administration is preparing to adjust the U.S. regulatory review system for e‑cigarettes and nicotine pouches, potentially by amending current review rules, simplifying some scientific‑study requirements, and shortening review timelines to get more non‑combustible nicotine products into the legal market faster. The Wall Street Journal, citing insiders, reports the FDA expects to announce related measures within the next few days, though the exact plan may still be tweaked.

One core element of the plan is to revisit the new tobacco‑product marketing application requirements adopted in 2021. Insiders say the FDA may add flexibility to reviews, including simplifying the scientific data that companies must submit, while also accelerating product review speed so more e‑cigarette and nicotine‑pouch products can obtain market authorization.

Under current U.S. law, new tobacco products must undergo FDA review before they can be marketed. The agency must assess whether a product’s launch meets the standard of protecting overall public health, weighing risks and potential benefits to existing users and non‑users. FDA review data show a huge volume of applications, with some products’ review times already far exceeding statutory limits.

Industry players have long complained about the FDA’s slow review pace. Reuters reported in early September that tobacco company Altria Group (MO‑US) has sued the FDA, demanding a reform of the new tobacco‑product review system. Altria notes that the law requires the FDA to decide within 180 days of receiving an application, but the company says the agency has never met that deadline, with some product applications delayed for years.

In its lawsuit, Altria says its On! nicotine‑pouch product has been held up by regulatory delays, while unauthorized foreign competitors continue to capture U.S. market share. The company and other plaintiffs ask the court to overturn the current system and require the FDA to create a new review mechanism. The FDA did not immediately respond to comment requests.

The regulatory shift could directly affect large tobacco firms’ strategies for new nicotine products. In addition to Altria, Philip Morris International (PM‑US) and British American Tobacco (BTI‑US) are also shifting resources toward e‑cigarettes, heated tobacco and nicotine pouches, so a shorter FDA review timeline could speed up product launches and expand legal product portfolios.

In recent months the FDA has begun speeding up reviews of certain products. On August 21, the agency approved 11 ZYN ULTRA nicotine‑pouch products from Swedish Match USA under its nicotine‑pouch pilot program. The approved flavors include Chill, Citrus, Cool Mint, Deep Freeze, Menthol, Peppermint, Smooth, Spearmint and Wintergreen, with nicotine strengths of 9 mg and 11 mg.

The FDA said that as of August 21 it had approved a total of 43 nicotine‑pouch products, 23 of which were cleared under the pilot program. The agency noted the pilot improves the review process by speeding issue resolution, shortening the time applicants need to respond to deficiency notices, and boosting scientific‑review efficiency, and that these lessons are now being applied to other new tobacco‑product applications.

On August 28 the FDA also cleared JUUL Labs’ JUUL2 e‑cigarette system for market, covering the device and two pod flavors—tobacco and menthol—totaling three products. FDA records show the clearance is part of a series of e‑cigarette and nicotine‑product decisions slated for 2026.

The possible regulatory adjustments under the Trump administration are also tied to the rapid growth of the illicit e‑cigarette market. Reform supporters argue that a robust legal market offering more FDA‑reviewed flavors and products could steer consumers away from unauthorized items. The government says its policy goals include keeping nicotine out of children’s hands, cracking down on street‑sold counterfeit e‑cigarettes, and providing adults seeking to quit traditional cigarettes with government‑deemed safer alternatives.

However, the policy direction has drawn opposition from public‑health groups and some bipartisan members of Congress. Critics warn that if the FDA lowers or simplifies evidence requirements—especially by easing flavor restrictions on fruit‑ and sweet‑tasting e‑cigarettes—it could raise youth exposure and use of nicotine products. Mitch Zeller, former director of the FDA’s Center for Tobacco Products who helped craft the 2021 rules, expressed skepticism about the current flavor‑product policy trajectory, saying illicit flavored e‑cigarettes should be tackled through enforcement, not by lowering evidentiary standards for market approval.

Some lawmakers have also voiced concerns about the FDA’s recent approvals of more flavored products. Republican Senator Susan Collins of Maine told a hearing this month that flavors such as blueberry and mango could make e‑cigarettes more appealing to young people. The controversy is expected to be a focal point at the Senate confirmation hearing on September 24 for Trump’s nominee for FDA commissioner, Heidi Overton.

This policy stance contrasts with the first Trump administration, when the FDA pushed to pull fruit‑flavored e‑cigarettes from retail outlets to curb youth use and warned that sweet flavors could attract large numbers of children to nicotine. In the current term, the regulatory emphasis has shifted toward building a legal product supply and speeding the entry of certain new‑type nicotine products into the market.

In May this year the FDA issued another guidance allowing certain tobacco products that have filed marketing applications but have not completed full scientific review to continue selling under specific conditions, and said it would prioritize enforcement based on related policy decisions. Public‑health groups have filed legal challenges to that guidance, arguing the FDA failed to provide adequate public participation when changing its regulatory approach.

For the tobacco industry, a faster FDA review mechanism could lower costs and market delays associated with waiting for new product approvals, and enable companies to expand non‑combustible product lines more quickly. Yet whether the policy will truly shorten review times, which scientific‑study requirements will be altered, and whether approval standards for flavored e‑cigarettes and nicotine pouches will change remain uncertain until the FDA formally releases its plan.

Overall, the reforms the Trump administration may pursue aim to find a new regulatory model that balances the FDA’s existing nicotine‑product review framework with a growing backlog of applications. Recent FDA actions—such as the nicotine‑pouch pilot and the JUUL2 clearance—show signs of accelerated review, and further amendments to the 2021 rules could markedly speed product launches. However, striking a balance between expanding legal product supply, combating the illicit market, and preventing increased youth use will remain the central controversy of this policy.

items.title: 高通推Sound Elite Gen 2音訊平台 AI能力大增2倍
items.title_en: Qualcomm Launches Sound Elite Gen 2 Audio Platform, AI Capability Doubles
paras: 高通(QCOM-US)今(24)日宣布推出Snapdragon Sound Elite Gen 2平台，進一步拓展音訊穿戴式裝置的可能性。該平台整合頂級的Snapdragon Sound技術、裝置上AI、以安全性為導向的雲端連網智慧能力，以及整合式微功耗Wi-Fi 6E，帶來更直覺、更個人化的體驗，能預判使用者需求並無縫回應，同時持續提供消費者所期待的音訊體驗，當中AI能力更比上代提升2倍。

高通資深副總裁暨XR、穿戴式裝置與個人AI總經理Ziad Asghar表示，公司研究顯示，高達70%的使用者希望穿戴式裝置具備先進AI能力。隨著AI成為核心能力，使用者將日益期待以更自然的方式與AI互動，而這些互動不一定都會透過螢幕進行，也可藉由自然對話實現，讓使用者只需與AI助理交談，就能即時獲得協助。透過Snapdragon Sound Elite Gen 2，我們正在迎接智慧音訊穿戴式裝置的全新時代，支援即時翻譯、情境感知協助、個人化聽覺體驗，以及結合音訊、視覺與AI的多模態互動。
Snapdragon Sound Elite Gen 2大幅提升音訊穿戴式裝置的裝置上AI能力，AI能力最高可達前代的2倍，並可支援多項智慧體驗同時運行。結合最高降低40%的功耗與整體晶片組的晶片面積最高縮減30%，該平台讓OEM廠商能提供反應更快速且隨時可用的個人AI體驗，包括支援搭載相機的裝置形態，藉由相機協助取得使用者周遭環境的情境資訊，而非僅用於拍攝相片。
此外，透過微功耗Wi-Fi 6E支援的雲端直連能力，Snapdragon Sound Apps & Agents讓音訊穿戴式裝置的體驗不再侷限於硬體本身，使其能存取AI助理、服務、內容與各類體驗，並可隨時間持續演進。
Snapdragon Sound Elite Gen 2結合頂級Snapdragon Sound技術與AI驅動功能，可持續因應聆聽者需求、所使用的裝置及周遭環境進行調適。
Snapdragon Sound Elite Gen 2支援多元裝置形態，包括耳塞式耳機、耳罩式耳機、開放式與混合式音訊設計、搭載相機的耳塞式耳機、音訊眼鏡，以及未來的多模態穿戴式裝置。為進一步加速創新，Snapdragon Sound Elite Gen 2參考設計將協助OEM廠商快速完成新一代個人AI裝置的原型開發、驗證與商業化。
paras_en: Qualcomm (QCOM-US) announced today (the 24th) the launch of the Snapdragon Sound Elite Gen 2 platform, further expanding the possibilities for audio wearables. The platform integrates top‑tier Snapdragon Sound technology, on‑device AI, security‑focused cloud‑connected intelligence, and integrated low‑power Wi‑Fi 6E, delivering a more intuitive, personalized experience that can anticipate user needs and respond seamlessly while continuing to provide the audio quality consumers expect, with AI capability twice that of the previous generation.

Senior Vice President and General Manager for XR, Wearables and Personal AI, Ziad Asghar, said Qualcomm’s research shows that up to 70% of users want wearables with advanced AI. As AI becomes a core capability, users will increasingly expect to interact with it in a natural way that doesn’t always rely on a screen, but can be achieved through conversational dialogue, allowing users to simply talk to an AI assistant for instant help.
