With Snapdragon Sound Elite Gen 2, we are ushering in a new era of smart audio wearables that support real‑time translation, context‑aware assistance, personalized listening experiences, and multimodal interaction that blends audio, visual and AI.

Snapdragon Sound Elite Gen 2 dramatically boosts on‑device AI for audio wearables, with AI performance up to twice that of the prior generation and the ability to run multiple smart experiences simultaneously. Combined with up to 40% lower power consumption and up to a 30% reduction in overall chipset area, the platform enables OEMs to deliver faster, always‑ready personal AI experiences, including camera‑equipped device forms that use the camera to gather contextual information about the user’s surroundings rather than just taking photos.

In addition, the low‑power Wi‑Fi 6E‑enabled cloud‑direct connectivity lets Snapdragon Sound Apps & Agents extend the wearable experience beyond the hardware itself, giving access to AI assistants, services, content and a variety of experiences that can evolve over time.

Snapdragon Sound Elite Gen 2 merges premium Snapdragon Sound technology with AI‑driven features that continuously adapt to the listener’s needs, the device being used, and the surrounding environment.

Snapdragon Sound Elite Gen 2 supports a wide range of device forms, including in‑ear earbuds, over‑ear headphones, open‑back and hybrid audio designs, camera‑enabled earbuds, audio glasses, and future multimodal wearables. To accelerate innovation, Snapdragon Sound Elite Gen 2 reference designs will help OEMs quickly prototype, validate and commercialize the next generation of personal AI devices.

items.title: 特斯拉最貴車型Roadster發布在即 期權市場卻異常冷靜
items.title_en: Tesla's Most Expensive Model Roadster Set to Launch, Yet Options Market Remains Unusually Calm
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US)新一代Roadster跑車即將在10月1日正式亮相，隨著公司重新開放預訂，這款延宕多年的旗艦跑車可能成為特斯拉迄今最昂貴的車型。不過，儘管Roadster發布、Semi電動卡車以及第3季交車數據等多項催化劑接連逼近，特斯拉期權市場卻尚未出現明顯升溫跡象，市場隱含波動率仍處於過去一年相對偏低的區間。
特斯拉目前重新開放Roadster預訂，買家需先以信用卡支付5,000美元可退款訂金，之後10天內再透過銀行電匯支付45,000美元，完成5萬美元的預訂流程。公司目前也已在加拿大及中國開放預訂，並表示10月1日的發布活動將公布Roadster的正式售價、具體規格及生產目標。由於特斯拉尚未公布最終售價，市場普遍預期新款Roadster價格將遠高於公司現有車型。
Roadster發布會預計在SpaceX位於德州麥格雷戈的測試設施舉行。這款跑車最早於2017年亮相，特斯拉當時同樣向消費者收取5萬美元訂金，並曾計畫在2020年開始交車，但後續因公司優先生產其他產品而多次延後。如今重新開放預訂，也讓外界再次關注特斯拉能否按照新的時間表推進量產與交車。
新一代Roadster最初公布的規格包括起售價20萬美元、百公里加速約1.9秒及620英里續航里程，另有售價25萬美元的Founder’s Series限量版本。此次重新設計後的最終規格仍待10月1日公布，而市場關注焦點也從單純的高性能電動車，延伸至特斯拉此前宣傳的航太技術整合可能性。
Roadster重新開放預訂之際，特斯拉期權市場的反應卻相對平淡。資料顯示，特斯拉1個月期隱含波動率約位於過去區間的第36百分位，即使Roadster發布等事件逐漸逼近，而且10月通常是市場波動較高的月份，相關指標仍低於平均水平。另一項30日期權隱含波動率約為41%, 對大型企業而言絕對水準不算低，但已接近特斯拉過去一年的波動率區間下緣。
這種期權市場表現，與特斯拉未來幾周密集的產品及財報催化劑形成對比。Semi電動卡車活動預計在9月24日舉行，Roadster則將在10月1日亮相，隨後還有第3季交車數據及財報公布。對一檔消息面經常可以出現約5%波動的股票而言，市場目前對短期波動的定價仍相對克制。
市場對Roadster的期待也受到特斯拉近期Cybercab發布會表現的影響。Cybercab於9月3日在奧斯汀亮相後，部分投資人反應失望，Wells Fargo(WFC-US)分析師更指出，特斯拉自駕計程車業務仍面臨「執行問題」。不過，特斯拉股價在Cybercab發布後逐步收復部分失地，隨著Roadster重新開放訂購，1個月期權權利金又處於相對低位，市場開始重新評估後續產品發布對股價的影響。

OpenInterest.PRO共同創辦人兼首席策略師Michael Khouw認為，市場此前對Cybercab發布的負面反應可能過度。Cybercab雖然未能立即帶來市場期待的顛覆性效果，但自駕計程車受到監管及實際部署等因素限制，要求產品一推出便產生大規模商業影響並不現實。他指出，未來數年的核心問題，並非特斯拉首款雙座自駕車在上市首日是否已經成熟，而是哪些企業能以具商業競爭力的成本生產數十萬甚至數百萬輛自駕車，並真正投入道路運營。
在估值方面，市場對特斯拉的爭議則更加直接。若以傳統汽車製造商的估值框架衡量，或將Uber Technologies(UBER-US)、Lyft(LYFT-US)等自駕叫車相關企業作為參考，特斯拉目前的估值倍數明顯偏高。資料顯示，特斯拉預期本益比約213倍，相較之下Uber約22倍，Ford Motor(F-US)約7倍，兩者之間存在顯著差距。
不過，支持特斯拉高估值的市場觀點認為，公司過去的發展並非單純按照傳統車企模式，包括大規模生產電動車、建立充電網絡、發展大型儲能系統，以及與SpaceX在航太領域形成的技術協同，都使部分投資人將特斯拉視為結合汽車、人工智慧、自駕、機器人及能源業務的科技企業，而非單純汽車製造商。因此，市場對特斯拉的估值也包含對未來自駕、機器人及能源業務發展的預期。
對期權交易而言，多項催化劑即將集中出現，理論上應可能推升短期期權溢價，但目前並未明顯發生。Khouw因此提出，與直接買進看漲期權相比，投資人也可以考慮牛市看漲價差策略，以降低期權權利金支出及事件落幕後波動率下降帶來的風險。他舉出的策略為10月30日到期、執行價380美元與440美元的看漲期權價差，涵蓋Roadster發布、第3季交車數據及後續財報等主要事件。

因此，Roadster雖然可能成為特斯拉最昂貴的量產車型之一，且5萬美元預訂金已重新開放，但目前期權市場並未同步反映出極端樂觀的短期波動預期。接下來市場焦點將集中在10月1日Roadster究竟公布什麼樣的售價、性能規格及量產目標，以及特斯拉能否把這款自2017年公布、原定2020年交車的跑車真正推向量產。對投資人而言，Roadster本身的產品吸引力與特斯拉能否落實量產時程，將成為發布後重新評估市場預期的重要觀察點。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) is set to unveil the next‑generation Roadster sports car on October 1, and with the company reopening reservations, the long‑delayed flagship could become Tesla’s most expensive model to date. However, despite the approaching Roadster launch, the Semi electric truck and Q3 delivery numbers, the Tesla options market has shown no clear signs of heating up, with implied volatility still in a relatively low range compared with the past year.

Tesla has now reopened Roadster reservations: buyers must first pay a refundable $5,000 deposit by credit card, then within ten days wire $45,000 to complete a $50,000 reservation. The company has also opened reservations in Canada and China and says the October 1 event will reveal the official price, detailed specs and production targets. Because Tesla has not disclosed the final price, the market generally expects the new Roadster to be priced well above any of its current models.

The Roadster launch is expected to take place at SpaceX’s test facility in McGregor, Texas. The car was first shown in 2017, when Tesla also collected a $50,000 deposit and planned deliveries for 2020, but the schedule was repeatedly pushed back as the company prioritized other products. Reopening reservations now has revived scrutiny of whether Tesla can stick to a new timeline for mass production and deliveries.

The initially announced specs for the new Roadster included a starting price of $200,000, a 0‑to‑60 mph time of about 1.9 seconds and a 620‑mile range, with a limited Founder’s Series priced at $250,000. Final specifications after the redesign will be disclosed on October 1, and market focus has shifted from pure high‑performance to the possible integration of aerospace technology that Tesla has previously touted.

When the Roadster reservations reopened, the Tesla options market reacted rather calmly. Data show the one‑month implied volatility sits around the 36th percentile of its historical range, even as the Roadster launch and other events draw near and October is typically a volatile month. The 30‑day implied volatility is about 41%, not low for a large cap but near the lower edge of Tesla’s volatility band over the past year.

This subdued options behavior contrasts with the flurry of product and earnings catalysts Tesla faces in the coming weeks. The Semi truck event is slated for September 24, the Roadster on October 1, followed by Q3 delivery data and earnings. For a stock that can swing roughly 5% on news, the market is still pricing short‑term moves conservatively.

Market expectations for the Roadster are also colored by the recent Cybercab rollout. After the Cybercab was unveiled in Austin on September 3, some investors expressed disappointment, and a Wells Fargo (WFC‑US) analyst noted that Tesla’s autonomous‑taxi business still faces “execution issues.” Nonetheless, Tesla’s share price has gradually recovered, and with the Roadster back on the reservation list and one‑month option premiums still low, the market is re‑evaluating the impact of upcoming product releases on the stock.

Michael Khouw, co‑founder and chief strategist at OpenInterest.PRO, believes the market over‑reacted negatively to the Cybercab launch. While the Cybercab did not deliver the disruptive impact some hoped for, autonomous taxis are constrained by regulation and deployment realities, making immediate large‑scale commercial effects unrealistic. He argues the core issue in the coming years will be which companies can produce tens or hundreds of thousands of self‑driving cars at commercially viable costs and actually put them on the road, rather than whether Tesla’s first two‑seat autonomous vehicle is fully mature on day one.

In valuation terms, the debate around Tesla is more straightforward. Using a traditional automaker valuation framework—or comparing to ride‑hailing players such as Uber Technologies (UBER‑US) and Lyft (LYFT‑US)—Tesla’s multiples appear markedly high. Data show Tesla’s forward P/E is roughly 213×, versus about 22× for Uber and around 7× for Ford Motor (F‑US).

However, proponents of Tesla’s lofty valuation argue the company’s growth has never followed a conventional car‑maker path. Massive EV production, a global charging network, large‑scale energy storage, and technology synergies with SpaceX position Tesla as a tech firm spanning automotive, AI, autonomous driving, robotics and energy, rather than a pure car manufacturer. Consequently, the market’s valuation reflects expectations for future autonomous, robotics and energy businesses.

For options traders, a cluster of catalysts should theoretically lift short‑term option premiums, yet that hasn’t materialized clearly. Khouw therefore suggests that instead of outright buying calls, investors might consider a bullish call spread to reduce premium outlay and mitigate the risk of volatility dropping after events. He cites a spread using October 30 calls with strikes at $380 and $440, covering the Roadster launch, Q3 delivery data and subsequent earnings.

Thus, while the Roadster may become one of Tesla’s most expensive production cars and the $50,000 reservation deposit is back on the table, the options market has not yet reflected an extremely optimistic short‑term volatility outlook. The next focus will be on what price, performance specs and production targets Tesla announces on October 1, and whether the car first unveiled in 2017 and originally slated for 2020 deliveries can finally reach mass production. For investors, the Roadster’s intrinsic appeal and Tesla’s ability to meet its production timeline will be key gauges for reassessing market expectations after the launch.

items.title: 高盛交易台：AI代理革命已至 美股蓄勢迎新一輪突破
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Trading Desk: AI Agent Revolution Arrives, US Stocks Poised for New Wave of Breakouts
paras: 高盛One-Delta交易台負責人Rich Privorotsky認為，市場正站在標普500指數與那斯達克指數新一輪突破的邊緣，驅動力來自AI代理帶來的深層生產率變革。
Privorotsky在最新報告中指出，儘管季節性因素不利、實際利率仍處高位、地緣政治尾部風險猶存，當前市場情緒與倉位的謹慎程度本身已構成上行潛力。
他表示，「這類行情人們往往參與度不足，因為所有人都在9月份忙著解釋它為何走不起來。」
在他看來，真正值得關注的變量是AI智慧代理的加速普及。他表示，此趨勢將「從根本上減少人、技術與資本之間的摩擦」，其宏觀效應是結構性的去通膨，而權益資產是捕捉這項變革最直接的工具。
Privorotsky以「憂慮之牆」（Wall of Worry）作為開篇框架，逐一盤點當前壓制市場情緒的因素——AI敘事的急劇切換、倉位與情緒的普遍謹慎、期中選舉、油價與利率的三重擾動——並認為上述風險均已被市場充分定價甚至過度消化。
他承認，當前正處於季節性維度最為不利的半月窗口，實際利率依然偏高，地緣政治的風險也客觀存在。
然而在他的分析框架中，這些因素恰恰構成了市場「低倉位、低參與度」的根源，而非阻斷行情的決定性障礙。
Privorotsky將論述核心落在「推理經濟」(Inference Economy)與AI智慧代理的規模化普及上。
他以Muse為案例指出，這不是終點，而是大量同類產品入場的起點，其影響將深刻改變個人與企業的生產方式，乃至溝通與交易的底層邏輯。
他表示，AI超級用戶此前已具備類似能力，但技術門檻高、維護成本大，普通用戶難以開箱即用。隨著大型企業承接安全、基礎設施與分發的底層責任，這一局面正在改變，「大量摩擦與租金汲取將從經濟體中消失」。
在他看來，這本身就是一次生產率躍升——資本向更有效率的方向再配置，那些阻礙經濟增長的「無效摩擦」隨之消散。他對這一趨勢的綜合判斷是：對整體權益市場的影響為正，且具有結構性去通膨屬性。
Privorotsky指出，推理經濟目前最劇烈的表現仍集中在CPU產業鏈，但他預計市場的判斷最終將變得更為廣泛而非聚焦。
他認為，傳統AI資本支出產業鏈同樣具備配置價值，只是彈性（beta）相對較低，而生產率紅利則將向更寬泛的行業擴散。
他特別點出台積電(TSM-US)的走勢——股價正處於高位且蓄勢突破——並將其視為全球硬體「母艦」發出的信號。同時，他觀察到一個值得關注的背離：金融板塊在科技股走強的同時明顯走弱，二階效應正在顯現。
整體來看，Privorotsky的結論是：代理革命已經到來，市場正在開始為一場重大結構性轉變定價，科技與半導體板塊的強勢買盤正是這一預期的直接體現。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs One-Delta trading desk head Rich Privorotsky believes the market is on the brink of a fresh breakout for both the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq, driven by deep productivity changes brought by AI agents.

Privorotsky notes in his latest report that despite adverse seasonal factors, real rates remaining high, and lingering geopolitical tail risks, the current cautious sentiment and positioning themselves already embed upside potential.
He says, "People tend to under‑participate in this kind of rally because everyone is busy in September trying to explain why it can’t get going."

In his view, the truly noteworthy variable is the accelerating adoption of AI smart agents, which he says will "fundamentally reduce friction among people, technology and capital," delivering a structural deflationary effect, with equity assets being the most direct tool to capture this change.

Privorotsky opens with a "Wall of Worry" framework, cataloguing the factors dampening sentiment—rapid shifts in the AI narrative, broad caution in positioning and sentiment, the mid‑term elections, and the triple shock of oil prices and rates—and argues these risks are already fully priced or even over‑digested by the market.
He acknowledges that we are currently in the most unfavorable half‑month window seasonally, with real rates still elevated and geopolitical risks objectively present.
However, in his analytical framework these elements actually underpin the market’s "low positioning, low participation" rather than constitute a decisive barrier to a rally.
Privorotsky centers his discussion on the "Inference Economy" and the mass rollout of AI smart agents.

He cites Muse as an example, noting it is not the endpoint but the start of a wave of similar products that will profoundly reshape how individuals and firms produce, communicate and transact at a fundamental level.

He says AI super‑users already possessed similar capabilities, but high technical barriers and maintenance costs kept them out of reach for ordinary users; as large firms take on security, infrastructure and distribution responsibilities, this is changing, and "the massive friction and rent‑seeking will disappear from the economy."

In his view this itself is a productivity jump—capital is re‑allocated toward greater efficiency, eliminating the "ineffective frictions" that hinder growth; his overall judgment is that the impact on the equity market is positive and carries a structural deflationary attribute.

Privorotsky points out that the most intense manifestation of the inference economy is still concentrated in the CPU supply chain, but he expects market perception to eventually broaden beyond that focus.
He believes traditional AI cap‑ex supply chains also have allocation value, albeit with lower beta, and that productivity gains will spread to a wider set of industries.

He highlights TSMC (TSM-US) as a case in point—its stock is at elevated levels and primed for a breakout—viewing it as a signal from the global hardware "mother ship," and notes a noteworthy divergence: financials are weakening even as tech stocks rally, indicating a second‑order effect emerging.

Overall, Privorotsky concludes that the agent revolution is here, the market is beginning to price in a major structural shift, and the strong buying in technology and semiconductor sectors is a direct manifestation of that expectation.

items.title: 麥當勞CEO：高通膨、客流疲軟成餐飲業「新常態」
items.title_en: McDonald’s CEO: High Inflation and Weak Foot Traffic Become the Restaurant Industry’s “New Normal”
paras: 麥當勞(MCD-US) 全球總裁兼執行長克里斯·坎普欽斯基（Chris Kempczinski）表示，預計低迷客流增長和高通膨會繼續給餐飲業帶來壓力。
坎普欽斯基周三（23日）接受採訪時說：「我和團隊談過的一件事是，需要停止把這稱為一個艱難的環境，而應該直接說，這就是當前經營環境，我們不期待情況會好轉。」
多年來坎普欽斯基一直在提醒投資者和分析師，麥當勞以及整個餐飲業正面臨「充滿挑戰的環境」。麥當勞最近一個季度公布的美國同店銷售額僅增長0.8%，同期美國門市客流量下降。
隨著汽油、食品雜貨等各項生活成本上漲，消費者減少外出就餐頻率，同時也開始避開較高菜單價格。
美國全國餐飲協會（National Restaurant Association）調查的餐飲業經營者數據顯示，2025年8月至2026年7月期間，除一個月外，其餘每個月客流量均淨下降。
為了吸引消費者，麥當勞及競爭對手紛紛加大折扣，但面臨成本上漲的並不只有消費者，麥當勞及加盟商等餐飲經營者也受到牛肉價格飆漲的影響。
坎普欽斯基表示，在麥當勞最大的幾個市場，過去五年牛肉成本幾乎翻了一倍。與此同時，人工和建設等其他成本也有所上升，進一步擠壓利潤率。
「總的來看，我們看到通膨具有很強粘性，這種粘性不僅出現在美國，全球各地都這樣。」
面對更加艱難經營環境，麥當勞正將重點放在從競爭對手手中爭奪消費者上。
坎普欽斯基表示：「在這樣的環境下，最重要的一點就是，你必須能夠贏得市場份額。你必須真正能夠從競爭對手那裡搶到增長。」
他補充稱，麥當勞可能仍需要考慮漲價，但必須謹慎，避免將消費者趕走。
paras_en: McDonald’s (MCD‑US) global president and chief executive Chris Kempczinski said he expects sluggish foot‑traffic growth and high inflation to continue putting pressure on the restaurant sector.

Kempczinski told reporters on Wednesday the 23rd that one thing his team has discussed is that we should stop calling this a “difficult environment” and instead say it is simply the current operating environment, and we do not expect conditions to improve.

For years Kempczinski has been reminding investors and analysts that McDonald’s and the broader restaurant industry are facing a “challenging environment.” In the most recent quarter McDonald’s reported U.S. same‑store sales growth of only 0.8%, while foot traffic at U.S. locations fell during the same period.
As gasoline, food and grocery costs rise, consumers are dining out less often and are also beginning to avoid higher‑priced menu items.
Data from the National Restaurant Association’s survey of operators shows that, for the period August 2025 to July 2026, foot traffic fell every month except one.

To attract diners, McDonald’s and its rivals have been increasing discounts, but it is not only consumers who face higher costs—McDonald’s and its franchisees are also feeling the impact of soaring beef prices.

Kempczinski said that in McDonald’s biggest markets, beef costs have almost doubled over the past five years, and at the same time labor, construction and other expenses have risen, further squeezing margins.
“Overall, we see inflation is very sticky, and that stickiness is not just in the United States—it’s happening around the world,” he said.
Facing a tougher operating environment, McDonald’s is focusing on winning consumers away from competitors.
Kempczinski said, “In this environment, the most important thing is that you have to be able to win market share. You really have to be able to take growth from the competition.”
He added that McDonald’s may still need to consider price increases, but it must do so cautiously to avoid driving customers away.

items.title: 全球拋售潮燒到日本 10年期日債殖利率飆上30年新高
items.title_en: Global Bond Sell‑off Reaches Japan as 10‑Year JGB Yield Hits 30‑Year High
paras: 隨著日本結束白銀週假期、市場重新開市，日本債市迎來劇烈震盪。日本10年期公債殖利率一路飆升，創下自1996年以來的最高水平，全面趕上並加入了近期不斷加劇的全球債券拋售浪潮。
在經歷為期三天的休市後，日本10年期公債殖利率於週四顯著上漲10個基點，攀升至3.075%。同時，各期限公債殖利率也全面走揚，其中5年期公債殖利率同樣上漲9.5個基點，達到2.37%的高位，顯示市場避險情緒與拋售壓力全面擴散。
分析指出，此輪日本債市的急跌走勢，緊密跟隨了美國公債市場的跌勢腳步。近期發布的強勁美國經濟數據，搭配公債標售需求疲軟，推升美國公債多數期限的殖利率衝上近20年來的最高點。
此外，國際油價的上漲進一步加劇了市場對全球通膨的隱憂，不僅強化了投資人對聯準會將繼續維持升息步調的預期，也透過全球資本流動牽動著日本國內市場。
回顧國內政策動向，日本央行雖於上週五上調基準利率，並暗示未來可能進一步收緊貨幣政策，但由於缺乏關於未來行動節奏與升息步伐的具體指引，導致市場交易員感到失望。
這使得日本公債殖利率同時暴露於日本央行潛在升息的預期，以及全球長期借貸成本重新定價的雙重強大衝擊之下。
除了外部全球債市的壓力，國內的財政隱憂也成為推波助瀾的關鍵。在持續通膨的背景下，投資人紛紛要求對持有日本國債給予更高的風險補償，進而引發這波拋售潮。
市場消息指出，日本政府據悉正考慮將中期防衛預算目標設定為國內生產毛額（GDP）的3.5%，藉此符合北約及其他美國盟友的標準。
然而，這項政策方向也無形中加劇了市場對首相高市早苗龐大支出計畫的擔憂，使日本債市面臨前所未有的多重考驗。
paras_en: As Japan’s silver‑week holiday ends and markets reopen, the Japanese bond market experiences sharp turbulence. The 10‑year Japanese government bond yield surged, reaching its highest level since 1996, fully catching up with and joining the intensifying global bond sell‑off.

After a three‑day market closure, the 10‑year JGB yield jumped 10 basis points on Thursday to 3.075%. At the same time, yields across all maturities rose, with the 5‑year yield also up 9.5 basis points to a high of 2.37%, indicating that hedging sentiment and selling pressure have spread broadly.

Analysts note that this rapid decline in Japan’s bond market closely mirrors the drop in U.S. Treasury markets. Recent strong U.S. economic data, combined with weak demand for Treasury auctions, have pushed yields on most U.S. maturities to near‑20‑year highs.

Furthermore, rising international oil prices have heightened concerns about global inflation, reinforcing expectations that the Fed will keep raising rates and influencing Japan’s market through global capital flows.

Looking back at domestic policy, the Bank of Japan raised its policy rate last Friday and hinted at possible further tightening, but the lack of concrete guidance on the pace and timing of future hikes left market participants disappointed.
This leaves Japanese bond yields exposed to both expectations of further BOJ rate hikes and the powerful impact of a global repricing of long‑term borrowing costs.

In addition to external bond‑market pressure, domestic fiscal worries have become a key catalyst. Amid persistent inflation, investors are demanding higher risk premiums for holding Japanese government debt, fueling the sell‑off.
Market sources say the Japanese government is reportedly considering setting its medium‑term defence budget target at 3.5% of GDP to meet NATO and other U.S. ally standards.
However, this policy direction also subtly amplifies concerns over Prime Minister Kishida’s large‑scale spending plans, subjecting Japan’s bond market to unprecedented multiple challenges.

items.title: 坐5望6？5年期美債殖利率衝破5%、10年站上5.1%　華爾街共識：股市「崩盤線」上移
items.title_en: Aiming for 5, Expecting 6? 5‑Year U.S. Treasury Yield Breaks 5%, 10‑Year Tops 5.1% – Wall Street Consensus Shifts Stock‑Market “Crash Line” Higher
paras: 美債遭遇新一輪猛烈拋售，5年期殖利率周三(23日)飆升近20個基點，自2007年來首破5%，2年期飆升近15個基點，突破4.9%，續創2024年底以來新高，10年期殖利率飆破5.1%，創近19年新高，但5%這一曾經被視為風險資產「減速帶」的警戒線，此次並未立刻引爆全球股市劇烈回調，反而凸顯出當前市場韌性與分歧並存的複雜格局。
華爾街對利率風險的研判正出現微妙分化。BlueBay市場策略主管Mike Bell指出，市場不存在絕對觸發拋售的「魔法點位」，關鍵在於殖利率與股票獲利回報之間的相對溢價。當無風險殖利率持續走高而企業獲利未見顯著擴張，股市風險補償被極限壓縮，資產配置天平才會真正傾斜，這意味著單一數值突破並不必然導致系統性崩跌，結構性對比才是核心。
股市展現超預期抗跌性，與經濟結構深層變化密切相關。摩根大通(下稱小摩)分析指出，隨著AI、先進製造與高端服務業權重上升，大量高景氣企業即便面對昂貴融資成本，仍有充沛現金流維繫資本擴張，削弱傳統貨幣政策的收緊傳導。
小摩近期與大型機構溝通後發現，投資者普遍認為迫使股市全面重估的「破壞閾值」已從5%被動上移至5.5%至6%區間，顯示市場對高利率的容忍度正在提升。
但5%以上的資本成本絕非可長期無視。景順全球資產配置主管Paul Jackson表示，美債作為全球定價錨，突破5%後對追求確定性資金具極強吸引力。根據景順的歷史量化模型，當10年債殖利率過去12個月移動均值攀升至4.72%上方，全球股市將受實質壓制。目前，該均值約4.34%，距離拐點仍有一定緩衝，但Jackson已開始縮減股票部位並加碼主權債券，展現出防禦性佈局。
聯準會(Fed)官員古爾斯比示警，殖利率短期觸及5%與長期停留5%以上完全不同，時間一長，債務滾動壓力終將侵蝕企業預算與資本開支。
Premier Miton投資長Neil Birrell分析指出，當前股市平靜源於多數機構獲利模型尚未完全計入「長期5%以上」的折現率，真正的考驗將發生在全市場集中重跑模型、下修遠期現金流假設之時。
在29兆美元美債市場主導的重新定價中，邊際壓力已在防線薄弱處暴露。數據顯示，伴隨美債殖利率走強吸引資本回流美元資產，新興市場債券與股票基金近期出現規模達數十億美元的明顯流出，主權債務海外發行節奏亦大幅降溫。對高負債與依賴外幣融資的市場而言，資本成本跳升的苦果正以更快速度兌現，全球金融市場的結構性分化或將進一步加劇。
paras_en: U.S. Treasuries faced a fresh wave of heavy selling, with the 5‑year yield surging almost 20 basis points on Wednesday (the 23rd) to break 5% for the first time since 2007. The 2‑year rose nearly 15 basis points, topping 4.9% and setting a new high since the end of 2024, while the 10‑year yield jumped past 5.1%, a near‑19‑year peak. Yet the 5% warning line, once seen as a “slow‑down zone” for risk assets, did not immediately trigger a sharp global equity correction; instead it highlighted a complex landscape where market resilience coexists with divergent views.

Wall Street’s assessment of rate risk is showing subtle divergence. BlueBay’s head of market strategy, Mike Bell, notes that there is no absolute “magic level” that automatically triggers a sell‑off; the key is the relative premium between yields and equity earnings returns. When risk‑free yields keep climbing while corporate profits do not expand markedly, equity risk compensation is squeezed to the limit and the asset‑allocation balance truly tips. This means a single number crossing a threshold does not necessarily cause a systemic crash—structural comparisons are what matter.

Equities have shown better‑than‑expected resistance, closely tied to deep structural shifts in the economy. JPMorgan (referred to as “JPM”) analysis points out that as AI, advanced manufacturing and high‑end services gain weight, many high‑growth companies can sustain capital expansion despite expensive financing, thanks to abundant cash flow, which weakens the transmission of traditional monetary tightening.

JPM recently found, after talks with large institutions, that investors generally believe the “break‑point” that would force a full equity re‑rating has moved passively from 5% to a 5.5%‑6% range, indicating rising tolerance for higher rates.

However, capital costs above 5% cannot be ignored indefinitely. Invesco’s global asset‑allocation head Paul Jackson says U.S. Treasuries serve as a global pricing anchor, and once yields break 5% they become extremely attractive to funds seeking certainty. According to Invesco’s historical quantitative model, when the 12‑month moving average of the 10‑year yield climbs above 4.72%, global equities face real pressure. The current average is about 4.34%, leaving some buffer before the inflection point, but Jackson has already begun trimming equity exposure and adding sovereign bonds, reflecting a defensive stance.

Fed official Christopher Waller warned that a short‑term yield touch of 5% is very different from a sustained level above 5%; over time, the debt‑rollover pressure will erode corporate budgets and capital spending.

Premier Miton’s chief investment officer Neil Birrell argues that today’s market calm stems from most institutions not yet fully incorporating a “long‑term >5%” discount rate into their profit models. The real test will come when the whole market has to re‑run models and downgrade forward cash‑flow assumptions.

In the $29 trillion U.S. Treasury‑dominated repricing, marginal pressure is already showing at weak points. Data show that as Treasury yields rise and attract capital back to dollar assets, emerging‑market bonds and equity funds have recently seen outflows of tens of billions of dollars, and sovereign‑debt issuance abroad has slowed sharply. For markets with high debt and reliance on foreign‑currency financing, the pain of rising capital costs is materialising faster, and structural divergence in global financial markets may intensify further.

items.title: DeepSeek揭大規模Agent訓練平台 單一任曾啟動3.2萬個沙盒
items.title_en: DeepSeek Unveils Large-Scale Agent Training Platform, Single Task Once Launched 32,000 Sandboxes
paras: DeepSeek創辦人梁文鋒署名的最新論文公開，首次系統披露Agent訓練沙盒平台DSec（DeepSeek Elastic Compute）的技術細節。
這篇於9月19日提交、由超過130人共同署名的論文顯示，DeepSeek已透過DSec支撐大規模Agent訓練與評測；平台每日服務約300萬個沙盒，尖峰同時運行數量超過38萬個。
Agent訓練需要大量沙盒
DSec曾出現在DeepSeek V4技術報告中。根據新論文，從DeepSeek V3.2到V4.1的強化學習訓練與評測，所有沙盒負載均運行於DSec。
一個生產單元約有160個CPU節點、3萬個CPU核心及250TB記憶體，並託管PB級鏡像。平台每秒可建立超過5000個沙盒，單一訓練任務最多曾一次啟動3.2萬個。
與圍繞靜態輸入、輸出和獎勵訊號進行的傳統大型語言模型訓練相比，Agent必須在環境中執行程式碼、呼叫工具、下達指令及修改檔案。每一步操作都可能改變環境狀態，後續動作則取決於先前結果。
因此，訓練不只需要模型與資料，還需要大量可執行任務、保存狀態，並在任務結束後恢復的工作環境。
這些沙盒並非持續使用CPU。Agent等待下一步操作時，CPU可能閒置，但記憶體及可寫入狀態仍須保留。
當沙盒數量達數萬個，批量建立、資源調度、環境複製與狀態管理便成為訓練能否穩定運行的關鍵。
四種後端共用一套介面
不同Agent任務所需的環境差異很大。簡單任務可能只需呼叫函數；軟體工程任務需要能安裝依賴、修改程式碼及執行測試的Linux環境；安全攻防、電腦操作或商業軟體任務，則可能需要更高程度的隔離或完整作業系統。
DSec為此提供FnCall、容器、Firecracker微型虛擬機及完整虛擬機四種後端。訓練框架透過同一套Python SDK，即可建立沙盒、執行指令並取得結果，無須分別適配底層環境。
平台收到請求後，先驗證身分與權限，再依叢集負載選擇節點並建立沙盒；鏡像資料則由3FS按需提供。
分層鏡像加快部署
大量沙盒還帶來環境部署問題。論文統計，DSec在一個生產週內使用了11,266個基礎鏡像、102,171個工作區及103個工具包；實際運行時，67.8%的沙盒會在基礎鏡像上疊加工作區或工具包。
若將所有組件包進單一鏡像，任一部分更新都可能需要重新建置及分發整個鏡像。
DSec因此把基礎鏡像、工作區及工具包拆成三個獨立版本的唯讀層，啟動沙盒時再組合。哪個組件變動，就更新對應部分。
論文也指出，沙盒實際讀取的資料僅占完整鏡像的4.2%至13.3%，因此平台將鏡像放在3FS上按需讀取，並把元資料預先載入本地。
在8,192個容器同時部署的測試中，按需載入耗時35分鐘，Docker冷拉取則超過60分鐘；單一節點的累計磁碟寫入量，也由約1,600GB降至約700GB。
Agent還可透過增量快照保存自行配置的環境，供後續沙盒恢復使用。
執行任務與GPU訓練分離
DeepSeek早期讓Agent推論、任務執行與模型訓練共用GPU資源。一旦GPU任務遭搶占，正在執行的任務也會中斷。從V4.1開始，DeepSeek將任務執行移至DSec獨立運行，使GPU訓練被搶占時，執行狀態仍可保留。
當本地叢集容量不足，DSec也支援向雲端擴容。論文指出，叢集使用率超過80%後，符合條件的沙盒可轉移至雲端虛擬機；在生產環境中，200台雲端虛擬機可承接約30%的尖峰負載。
真實環境也帶來安全挑戰
沙盒越接近真實環境，Agent的操作風險也越高。論文記錄，部分Agent曾翻查日誌、偽造RPC請求、修改系統程式，或掃描可連線服務、下載外部程式碼，試圖透過預期流程以外的方式完成任務。另有操作造成核心崩潰，或使日誌膨脹至數十GB。
DSec使用AppArmor及eBPF限制檔案、連線與網路存取，並可依任務階段調整規則。不過，論文也指出，現有措施只能涵蓋部分風險，仍難以完全防範核心層級漏洞。
這篇論文呈現的DSec，是DeepSeek為Agent訓練建立的執行平台：在大量沙盒之間兼顧建立速度、環境更新、狀態保存與安全隔離。
隨著Agent任務延長、互動步驟增加，如何讓大規模執行環境穩定運行並控制資源消耗，將持續考驗這套基礎設施。
paras_en: DeepSeek founder Liang Wenfeng signed the latest paper, which publicly discloses for the first time the technical details of the Agent training sandbox platform DSec (DeepSeek Elastic Compute).

The paper, submitted on September 19 and co‑authored by more than 130 people, shows that DeepSeek uses DSec to support large‑scale Agent training and evaluation; the platform serves about 3 million sandboxes per day, with peak concurrent executions exceeding 380,000.
Agent training requires massive numbers of sandboxes.

DSec previously appeared in the DeepSeek V4 technical report. According to the new paper, all sandbox workloads for reinforcement‑learning training and evaluation from DeepSeek V3.2 to V4.1 run on DSec.

A production unit comprises roughly 160 CPU nodes, 30,000 CPU cores and 250 TB of memory, and hosts petabyte‑scale images. The platform can create over 5,000 sandboxes per second, and a single training task once launched as many as 32,000 sandboxes at once.

Unlike traditional large‑language‑model training that revolves around static inputs, outputs and reward signals, an Agent must execute code in an environment, call tools, issue commands and modify files. Every step can change the environment state, and subsequent actions depend on prior results.
Therefore training needs not only models and data but also a large number of executable tasks, state‑preserving workspaces, and the ability to restore the environment after a task finishes.
These sandboxes do not continuously consume CPU. When an Agent waits for the next action, the CPU may be idle, but memory and writable state must be retained.
When sandbox counts reach tens of thousands, batch creation, resource scheduling, environment cloning and state management become critical to stable training operation.
Four back‑ends share a single interface

Different Agent tasks require vastly different environments. Simple tasks may only need function calls; software‑engineering tasks need a Linux environment that can install dependencies, modify code and run tests; security‑offense, desktop automation or commercial‑software tasks may require higher isolation or a full operating system.

DSec provides four back‑ends for this purpose: FnCall, containers, Firecracker micro‑VMs and full virtual machines. Training frameworks can use the same Python SDK to create sandboxes, execute commands and retrieve results without adapting to each underlying environment.
When the platform receives a request, it first verifies identity and permissions, then selects nodes based on cluster load and creates the sandbox; image data is supplied on demand by 3FS.
Layered images accelerate deployment

Massive numbers of sandboxes also create deployment challenges. The paper counts that DSec used 11,266 base images, 102,171 workspaces and 103 toolkits in a single production week; in practice 67.8% of sandboxes overlay a workspace or toolkit on a base image.
If all components were packed into a single image, any update to a part would require rebuilding and redistributing the entire image.
Thus DSec splits the base image, workspace and toolkit into three independent read‑only layers and composes them when launching a sandbox. Only the changed component needs to be updated.
The paper also notes that the data actually read by a sandbox occupies only 4.2% to 13.3% of a full image, so the platform stores images on 3FS for on‑demand reading and pre‑loads metadata locally.

In a test deploying 8,192 containers simultaneously, on‑demand loading took 35 minutes, whereas a cold Docker pull exceeded 60 minutes; cumulative disk writes on a single node dropped from about 1,600 GB to roughly 700 GB.
Agents can also save their custom‑configured environments via incremental snapshots for later sandbox restoration.
Task execution is separated from GPU training

In DeepSeek’s early days, Agent inference, task execution and model training shared GPU resources. If a GPU task was preempted, the running task would be interrupted. Starting with V4.1, DeepSeek moved task execution to run independently on DSec, so execution state is retained even when GPU training is preempted.

When local cluster capacity is insufficient, DSec also supports cloud expansion. The paper states that once cluster utilization exceeds 80%, eligible sandboxes can be migrated to cloud VMs; in production, 200 cloud VMs can handle about 30% of peak load.
Real‑world environments also bring security challenges

The closer a sandbox mirrors a real environment, the higher the risk of Agent‑induced operations. The paper records that some Agents have inspected logs, forged RPC requests, modified system programs, scanned reachable services, downloaded external code, and attempted to complete tasks via non‑standard flows. Other actions caused kernel crashes or inflated logs to tens of gigabytes.

DSec uses AppArmor and eBPF to restrict file, connection and network access, and can adjust rules per task phase. However, the paper also points out that existing measures only cover part of the risk and cannot fully prevent core‑level vulnerabilities.

The DSec presented in this paper is DeepSeek’s execution platform for Agent training: it balances sandbox creation speed, environment updates, state preservation and security isolation across massive numbers of sandboxes.
As Agent tasks become longer and involve more interaction steps, keeping a large‑scale execution environment stable while controlling resource consumption will continue to test this infrastructure.

items.title: 若獲准進入美國市場 中國車廠市占率可能突破10%
items.title_en: If Approved to Enter US Market, Chinese Automakers' Share Could Exceed 10%
paras: 市場研究機構 Mobility Global 預估，若美國放寬中國車廠的銷售限制，到了 2038 年，中國車廠在美國的年銷量可能達 170 萬輛。依該機構評估的其中一種情境推算，這相當於全球第二大新車市場約 11% 的市占率。
在現行政策下，中國企業製造的汽車與卡車實際上無法進入美國市場。Mobility Global 美國汽車銷售預測副總監 Peter Nagle 周三(23日)在底特律向記者表示，未來 10 年，美國解除對北美製造的中國車廠汽車所設障礙的機率「偏低至中等」。
上述預測假設，由於美國關稅高昂，從中國直接進口汽車仍將形同遭到禁止。
Nagle 指出，「中國產品的價格明顯低於」其他汽車品牌。中國企業旗下車廠在其他國家銷售的新款小型與中型跨界休旅車，價格約與美國二手車均價相當。他說，從帳面上看，這對美國消費者相當有吸引力。
不過，美國消費者能否買到這些車，取決於政策制定者是否撤銷禁止搭載中國車載資訊娛樂系統、地圖或其他聯網服務的汽車上路的規定。
川普總統也對從加拿大及墨西哥進口的商品實施懲罰性貿易限制。目前幾乎沒有跡象顯示，這些限制短期內會放寬；部分美國國會議員甚至推動更嚴格的規定，試圖永久禁止中國汽車進入市場。
Nagle 表示，比亞迪(002594-CN) 、吉利汽車(00175-HK) 與上汽集團(600104-CN) 等中國車廠，最快可能從 2029 年起，試圖透過墨西哥的廠房向美國出口。一旦熱銷車款的年銷量突破約 4,000 輛，這些企業便可能在下一個十年將產能轉移至美國本土的新廠。
他指出，此類車款的需求可望為美國新車市場每年挹注約 60 萬輛的銷量，為近年來多半陷入停滯的整體市場注入動能。
不過Nagle也強調，中國品牌在美國取得的任何市占突破，都將侵蝕現有車廠的市場版圖，每年受影響的規模約達 100 萬輛。
其中，流失的市占率預料主要將由日產（Nissan）、現代汽車（Hyundai）及豐田汽車（Toyota）等其他亞洲品牌承擔。
Mobility Global 於今年 7 月自標普全球（S&P Global）分拆。
paras_en: Mobility Global, a market research firm, estimates that if the United States relaxes sales restrictions on Chinese automakers, annual sales of Chinese‑made vehicles in the US could reach 1.7 million units by 2038. In one scenario evaluated by the firm, this would represent roughly an 11% market share in the world’s second‑largest new‑car market.

Under current policy, cars and trucks manufactured by Chinese companies cannot enter the US market at all. Peter Nagle, deputy director of US auto‑sales forecasting at Mobility Global, told reporters in Detroit on Wednesday (the 23rd) that the likelihood of the US removing barriers to Chinese‑made vehicles over the next decade is “low to moderate.”
The forecast assumes that, because US tariffs are high, direct imports of cars from China will effectively remain prohibited.

Nagle noted that “Chinese products are clearly priced lower” than other automotive brands. New small‑ and midsize crossover SUVs sold by Chinese‑owned manufacturers in other countries are priced roughly on par with the average US used‑car price. He said that on paper this would be very attractive to US consumers.

However, whether US consumers can actually purchase these vehicles depends on whether policymakers repeal the rules that ban cars equipped with Chinese infotainment systems, maps, or other connected services from being driven on US roads.

President Trump also imposed punitive trade restrictions on goods imported from Canada and Mexico. There is little sign that these restrictions will be eased in the short term; some US lawmakers are even pushing for stricter rules that would permanently bar Chinese cars from the market.

Nagle said Chinese automakers such as BYD (002594‑CN), Geely (00175‑HK) and SAIC Motor (600104‑CN) could as early as 2029 try to export to the US via factories in Mexico. If a hot‑selling model’s annual sales exceed about 4,000 units, these firms could shift production to new plants in the United States over the following decade.
He added that demand for such models could inject roughly 600,000 vehicles per year into the US new‑car market, providing a boost to an overall market that has largely stalled in recent years.
Nagle also stressed that any market‑share gains by Chinese brands in the US would erode the existing manufacturers’ footprints, affecting roughly 1 million vehicles per year.
The lost share is expected to be taken up mainly by other Asian brands such as Nissan, Hyundai and Toyota.
Mobility Global was spun off from S&P Global in July of this year.

items.title: 美債殖利率飆升會怎樣？房貸、車貸與企業融資變貴 股市也承壓
items.title_en: What Happens When US Treasury Yields Surge? Mortgages, Auto Loans and Corporate Financing Get Costlier, Stock Market Under Pressure
paras: 美國公債殖利率週三 (23 日) 急升，10 年期美債殖利率盤中觸及 5.125%，來到全球金融危機前的水準。這波漲勢若持續，影響將從債市傳至房貸、車貸與企業融資，推高借款成本，並可能壓抑消費與投資。當天美股下跌，利率敏感類股首當其衝。
債市賣壓來自多項因素。美國 9 月製造業採購經理人調查結果高於預期，顯示工業活動升溫；油價上漲，加深市場對通膨的憂慮。同日標售的 5 年期美債需求疲弱，也促使投資人賣出債券、推升殖利率。
聯準會 (Fed) 的利率前景同樣牽動債市。Fed 理事巴爾 (Michael Barr) 週三表示，為使通膨回到 2% 目標，仍須進一步升息。
分析指出，截至報導時，市場預估 Fed 10 月升息 1 碼的機率接近 70%，高於一週前的 48%，以及一個月前的不到 10%。
10 年期美債殖利率週三觸及 5.125%，創 2007 年以來最高。對 Fed 利率預期較敏感的 2 年期美債殖利率上升超過 13 個基點，突破 4.9%。債券價格與殖利率走勢相反，這波急升也使持有美債及其他債券的投資人面臨價格下跌。
對一般家庭而言，最直接的變化是借錢更貴。
10 年期美債殖利率是房貸等長期借款利率的重要參考。根據 Mortgage News Daily，美國 30 年期房貸利率已達 7.26%，過去幾週上升逾 0.25 個百分點，較一年前則高出近 1 個百分點。房貸成本繼續上升，可能進一步壓抑部分地區已顯疲弱的房市。
車貸、信用卡及其他消費信貸也面臨壓力。Fed 上週升息 1 碼後，作為浮動利率信貸參考的基本利率升至 7%。美國家庭負債總額接近 19 兆美元，消費支出又占經濟活動將近七成，借貸成本提高可能逐步削弱民眾支出意願。
安聯貿易北美資深經濟學家 Dan North 以汽車市場為例指出，貸款變貴會讓部分消費者更難買車；購車需求下降，接著可能減少汽車業對勞工的需求，使經濟放緩。
North 也認為，存款戶雖可望取得稍高利息，但一般儲蓄帳戶利率目前約為 0.37%，增加的收益難以抵銷家庭在住房及其他貸款上承受的壓力。
企業同樣難以置身事外。
美債殖利率上升的影響已擴及公司債與房貸證券市場；North 指出，借款能力較弱的中小企業，尤其容易受到信貸取得難度增加的影響。
銀行可能因放款利率提高及存放款利差擴大而受惠，但若企業與家庭減少借貸，貸款需求也會受到壓抑。
金融市場與美股大盤已先反映利率壓力。週三標普 500 指數下跌約 0.8%，那斯達克指數跌約 1.1%，道瓊跌約 0.7%；公用事業、房地產及非必需消費類股表現較弱。
除了借款成本上升可能拖累經濟，債券殖利率竄高，進一步提高債券吸引力，也使資金可能由股市轉向債市。
Bryn Mawr Trust 投資策略主管 Andrew Davis 指出，這波債市賣壓反映市場同時面對經濟活動轉強與通膨壓力上升：成長較強，使經濟有能力承受較高利率；通膨持續，則限縮 Fed 降低利率的空間。對債市而言，兩股力量同時出現，使投資人必須重新評估高利率會維持多久。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury yields spiked sharply on Wednesday (the 23rd), with the 10‑year yield hitting 5.125% intraday – a level not seen since before the global financial crisis. If the rally continues, the impact will flow from the bond market into mortgages, auto loans and corporate financing, raising borrowing costs and potentially dampening consumption and investment. U.S. equities fell that day, with rate‑sensitive sectors hit first.

The sell‑off in bonds was driven by several factors. A September U.S. manufacturing PMI came in above expectations, signalling hotter industrial activity; higher oil prices deepened inflation worries. On the same day, weak demand for 5‑year Treasuries at auction also prompted investors to sell bonds, pushing yields higher.
The Fed’s rate outlook also tugged at the bond market. Fed Governor Michael Barr said on Wednesday that further rate hikes are needed to bring inflation back to the 2% target.
Analysts noted that, at the time of reporting, the market’s probability of a one‑point Fed hike in October was close to 70%, up from 48% a week earlier and less than 10% a month earlier.

The 10‑year Treasury yield reached 5.125% on Wednesday, the highest since 2007. The two‑year yield, which is more sensitive to Fed expectations, rose more than 13 basis points, breaking above 4.9%. Because bond prices move opposite to yields, the sharp rise also means holders of Treasuries and other bonds are seeing price declines.
For ordinary households, the most immediate change is that borrowing becomes more expensive.

The 10‑year Treasury yield is a key benchmark for long‑term loan rates such as mortgages. According to Mortgage News Daily, the U.S. 30‑year mortgage rate has climbed to 7.26%, up more than 0.25 percentage points over the past few weeks and nearly 1 point higher than a year ago. Rising mortgage costs could further suppress a housing market that is already showing signs of weakness in some regions.

Auto loans, credit cards and other consumer credit are also feeling the pressure. After the Fed’s one‑point hike last week, the benchmark rate that underlies variable‑rate credit rose to 7%. U.S. household debt is close to $19 trillion, and consumer spending accounts for roughly 70% of economic activity, so higher borrowing costs could gradually erode willingness to spend.

Allianz Trade North America senior economist Dan North used the auto market as an example, noting that more expensive financing will make it harder for some consumers to buy cars; weaker car demand could then reduce labor needs in the automotive sector, slowing the economy.

North also pointed out that while depositors may earn slightly higher interest, the average savings‑account rate is only about 0.37% right now, so the extra yield is unlikely to offset the pressure families face from higher housing and other loan costs.
Companies are similarly unable to stay out of the fallout.

The rise in Treasury yields has already spilled over into corporate bonds and mortgage‑backed securities; North said that smaller firms with weaker credit profiles are especially vulnerable as access to financing becomes more difficult.
Banks may benefit from higher loan rates and wider net interest margins, but if businesses and households cut back on borrowing, loan demand will also be suppressed.

Financial markets and the broad U.S. equity index have already priced in rate pressure. On Wednesday the S&P 500 fell about 0.8%, the Nasdaq dropped roughly 1.1% and the Dow slid about 0.7%; utilities, real estate and discretionary stocks lagged behind.
Beyond higher borrowing costs potentially dragging on the economy, soaring bond yields make bonds more attractive, which could shift capital away from equities toward fixed income.

Bryn Mawr Trust investment‑strategy head Andrew Davis said the current bond‑market sell‑off reflects a market confronting both stronger economic activity and rising inflation: robust growth gives the economy capacity to bear higher rates, while persistent inflation limits the Fed’s room to cut rates. With those two forces at play, investors must reassess how long elevated rates are likely to persist.

items.title: 2奈米晶片+雙2億像素！小米18 Pro發布 硬體級防窺螢幕與AI背景螢幕成最大變化 盧偉冰：AI手機時代從這開始
items.title_en: 2nm Chip + Dual 200-Megapixel Cameras! Xiaomi 18 Pro Launched with Hardware-Level Privacy Screen and AI Background Display as Biggest Changes – Lu Weibing: The AI Phone Era Starts Here
paras: 小米周三(23日)晚間在北京舉行秋季新品發表會，直接推出小米18 Pro、18 Pro Max雙尺寸影像科技旗艦，並同步帶來平板9系列、手環11、手錶S5及多款科技家電，集團總裁盧偉冰把這一代定義為「數位系列史上最大升級」，核心是2奈米新平台、硬體級防窺螢幕、AI百變背屏、徠卡雙2億影像和澎湃OS4超級小愛2.0。

性能端是本輪最硬一步。小米18 Pro全球首發第六代驍龍8至尊版，18 Pro Max首發第六代驍龍8超級至尊版，皆基於2奈米GAA製程；高通資料稱新平台採用客製化Oryon CPU、新架構Adreno GPU與Hexagon NPU，超級至尊版搭配X105調製解調器、FastConnect 88005G，CPU主頻亦衝到5GHz級別，18Pro的GPU性能提升35%、功耗降40%、NPU推理提升80%等區間，Pro Max再用Offset PoP高導熱封裝，官方稱峰值性能持續時長提升100%，《原神》極高畫質90fpsps幀可連續1小時滿時插幀。
電池方面，18 Pro搭配7000mAh、Pro Max搭配8500mAh金沙江電池，全系100W有線、50W無線；Pro Max透明探索版機身約240g、厚8.39mm。
螢幕是本次差異化重點。全系超級像素2.0，M11發光材料、全RGB排列、4000nit峰值、1—120Hz LTPO；Pro 6.4英寸、Pro Max螢幕6.9吋，正面邊框均壓到0.99mm。真正區別於貼防窺膜方案的是硬體級防窺：像素內部分常規像素與限光防窺像素，日常全開，正面畫質接近普通螢幕；開啟後關閉常規像素、僅留防窺像素，配合全RGB子像素降低解析度損失。
螢幕可依應用程式加入防窺名單，支付寶、銀行、微信等進入後自動限側視；通知氣泡、分割畫面、小窗可只做局部動態防窺，超級小愛也能依公司、地鐵、機場等位置設規則。體驗樣機在左右45°側視時，側向亮度可降到3%以下，解決傳統防窺膜「正面發灰、亮度折扣」的老問題。
背景螢幕從17 Pro的「妙享」升級為18 Pro Max的「第二桌面」。Deco把雙攝嵌進玻璃，平面一體，解決上一代鏡頭凸起積灰、放桌翹頭的問題；背景螢幕976×596、400PPI、1—120Hz、4000nit。
玩法不再只停留在桌布、萌寵、自拍取景，而是首批100多款應用卡，支援提示字產生工具卡，也支援AI上傳人像、寵物、IP生成動態形象與合照。手機倒扣桌面時，看通知、切音樂、定鬧鐘、記待辦、控智能家居可直接在背面完成。
影像上，18 Pro系列全焦段徠卡三攝，主攝與長焦雙2億雙大底。 Pro Max主攝光影獵人960L、1/1.28吋、F1.67、OIS；潛望長焦HP5、1/1.56吋、75mm等值、F2.4、OIS，支援12cm微距；超廣5000萬。雙大底思路是用主攝+長焦覆蓋常用焦段，中間46mm、150mm、200mm等靠高像素裁切​​，降低第三顆中焦的重複堆料。
藍調時段不強行拉亮夜景，「傳奇一瞬」走端雲協同，多幀RAW傳雲端用影像大模型重做影調、景深、現代膠卷/CCD/現代經典鏡頭模擬，並給予影像大模型重做影調、景深、現代膠卷/CCD/現代經典鏡頭模擬。HDR管線改RGB Gainmap，重新適配高亮螢幕；新增「原色」模式弱化徠卡高反差，把鮮豔、經典、寫實交回用戶。影片全焦段4K60杜比視界，OpenGate全感測畫幅方便橫豎二次裁切。
澎湃OS4接入小米MiMo，超級小愛2.0可調用260多個系統工具，做行程規劃、網頁整理、跨設備便籤、平板/電腦/家電協同。平板9用11.2吋、平板9 Pro用12.5吋螢幕，全系澎湃OS4與PC級應用、AI筆記；手環11、手錶S5補齊健康入口；家電側把AI推進電視、淨煙機、門鎖，呼應「人車家全生態」
盧偉冰直言當前「真正AI手機」仍距離日常很遠，18 Pro系列是小米用AI改造手機的開始，而非終局。盧偉冰指出，過去五年小米研發投入人民幣1055億元，未來五年計畫不少於2000億元，方向集中在AI、晶片、OS底層與跨裝置協同。
價格與定位上，18 Pro 12+256GB 5999元、最高16+1TB 8999元；18 Pro Max 6999元起、1TB 9999元，透明特別版進一步上探。防窺、背屏、雙2億把Pro Max推到「準Ultra」：它不靠Leica標證明旗艦，而靠隱私屏、副屏工作流、大模型影像建立辨識度。
對小米而言，數位系列從早期卷影像、再捲個性化，到18代把晶片—螢幕—背屏—大模型串成一套，邏輯已從「單點水桶」轉向「AI場景差異化」；後續要看背屏應用生態、超級小愛跨App執行準確率，以及防折損能否被使用者接受。
paras_en: Xiaomi held its autumn product launch in Beijing on Wednesday evening (the 23rd), unveiling the dual‑size imaging‑technology flagships Xiaomi 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, along with the Tablet 9 series, Band 11, Watch S5 and a range of smart home appliances. Group President Lu Weibing described this generation as the "biggest upgrade in the Digital series ever," centered on a 2nm new platform, hardware‑level privacy screen, AI‑driven versatile rear display, Leica dual 200‑megapixel cameras, and the powerful OS 4 with Super XiaoAI 2.0.

Performance is the hardest step in this round. The Xiaomi 18 Pro globally debuts the 6th‑gen Snapdragon 8 Supreme, while the 18 Pro Max launches the 6th‑gen Snapdragon 8 Super Supreme, both built on a 2nm GAA process. Qualcomm data says the new platform uses a custom Oryon CPU, a new‑architecture Adreno GPU and Hexagon NPU; the Super Supreme version pairs with an X105 modem and FastConnect 8800 5G, with CPU clocks reaching the 5 GHz range. The 18 Pro’s GPU performance is up 35%, power consumption down 40%, and NPU inference up 80%. The Pro Max adds an Offset PoP high‑thermal‑conductivity package, with the vendor claiming a 100% increase in sustained peak performance and the ability to run Genshin Impact at ultra‑high settings at 90 fps for a full hour without frame drops.

In terms of battery, the 18 Pro is equipped with a 7,000 mAh cell and the Pro Max with an 8,500 mAh Jinsha River battery, both supporting 100 W wired and 50 W wireless charging. The Pro Max transparent exploration edition weighs about 240 g and is 8.39 mm thick.

The display is the key differentiator this time. The whole lineup uses Super‑Pixel 2.0, M11 emissive material, full‑RGB sub‑pixel arrangement, a 4,000‑nit peak brightness and a 1–120 Hz LTPO refresh rate. The Pro has a 6.4‑inch screen, the Pro Max a 6.9‑inch panel, and the front bezels are both compressed to 0.99 mm. Unlike the usual privacy‑film approach, Xiaomi implements hardware‑level privacy: each pixel contains regular sub‑pixels and light‑blocking privacy sub‑pixels. When the privacy mode is off, the screen looks like a normal display; when turned on, regular sub‑pixels are disabled, leaving only the privacy sub‑pixels, and the full‑RGB layout reduces resolution loss.

Apps can add themselves to a privacy whitelist, so services such as Alipay, banks and WeChat automatically block side‑viewing after entry; notification bubbles, split‑screen and picture‑in‑picture can apply dynamic privacy only to specific areas, and Super XiaoAI can set rules based on location like company, subway or airport. In demo units, side‑view brightness at 45° drops below 3%, solving the long‑standing issue of traditional privacy films that cause front‑side graying and brightness loss.

The background display upgrades from the 17 Pro’s “MiaoXiang” to the 18 Pro Max’s “Second Desktop.” Deco embeds the dual cameras into the glass for a flat, integrated look, eliminating the protruding lens and dust‑accumulation problems of the previous generation. The rear screen measures 976 × 596 pixels, 400 PPI, 1–120 Hz and 4,000 nit peak brightness.

The usage scenario goes beyond wallpapers, virtual pets and selfie framing. Over a hundred app cards are supported, including prompt‑generation tool cards, AI‑generated portraits, pets, IP‑based dynamic avatars and group photos. When the phone is flipped over, users can view notifications, control music, set alarms, manage to‑do lists and operate smart‑home devices directly on the rear screen.

On the imaging side, the 18 Pro series features a Leica triple‑camera system covering all focal lengths, with both the main sensor and the telephoto sensor offering 200 megapixels and large sensors. The Pro Max’s primary camera is the Light‑Hunter 960L, 1/1.28‑inch, f/1.67, OIS; the periscope telephoto is the HP5, 1/1.56‑inch, 75 mm equivalent, f/2.4, OIS, supporting 12 cm macro; the ultra‑wide is 50 MP. The dual‑large‑sensor strategy uses the main and telephoto lenses to cover the most used focal ranges, while intermediate focal lengths (46 mm, 150 mm, 200 mm) are achieved by high‑resolution cropping, reducing redundancy of a third mid‑range lens.

During blue‑light periods, the phone does not forcibly brighten night scenes. The “Legendary Moment” mode uses cloud‑based collaboration: multiple RAW frames are uploaded to the cloud where a large‑scale image model re‑processes tone, depth of field and applies modern film/CCD/classic lens simulations. The HDR pipeline switches to an RGB Gainmap to better suit high‑brightness displays; a new “Original Color” mode tones down Leica’s high contrast, returning vivid, classic, realistic colors to the user. Video across all focal lengths supports 4K 60 fps Dolby Vision, and the OpenGate full‑sensor capture makes horizontal and vertical re‑cropping easy.

HyperOS 4 integrates Xiaomi MiMo, allowing Super XiaoAI 2.0 to invoke over 260 system tools for itinerary planning, web summarization, cross‑device note‑taking, and tablet/PC/appliance collaboration. Tablet 9 comes with an 11.2‑inch screen, Tablet 9 Pro with a 12.5‑inch display; the entire lineup runs HyperOS 4 with PC‑grade apps and AI note‑taking. Band 11 and Watch S5 complete the health ecosystem, while AI is pushed into TVs, air purifiers, and smart locks, reflecting the "person‑car‑home full ecosystem" vision.

Lu Weibing candidly said that a truly "AI phone" is still far from everyday reality, and the 18 Pro series marks Xiaomi’s start of using AI to transform smartphones, not the end point. He noted that Xiaomi has invested RMB 105.5 billion in R&D over the past five years and plans to spend at least RMB 200 billion in the next five, focusing on AI, chips, OS fundamentals and cross‑device collaboration.

Pricing and positioning: the 18 Pro starts at ¥5,999 for the 12 GB + 256 GB model and goes up to ¥8,999 for the 16 GB + 1 TB version; the 18 Pro Max starts at ¥6,999, with a 1 TB model at ¥9,999, and the transparent special edition is priced even higher. The privacy screen, rear display and dual 200‑MP sensors push the Pro Max into a "near‑Ultra" category: it doesn’t rely on Leica certification to prove its flagship status, but on privacy screen, secondary‑screen workflow and large‑model imaging to stand out.

For Xiaomi, the Digital series has evolved from early image‑centric devices, to personalized experiences, and now with the 18th generation links chip, display, rear screen and large‑model AI into a cohesive system. The logic has shifted from a "single‑point bucket" to "AI‑driven scenario differentiation." Future success will depend on the rear‑screen app ecosystem, the accuracy of Super XiaoAI’s cross‑app execution, and whether users accept the durability of the new display technology.

items.title: 美國期中選舉倒數一個多月 科技股可能面臨麻煩？
items.title_en: U.S. Midterm Election Less Than a Month Away: Could Tech Stocks Face Trouble?
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，距離美國期中選舉只剩一個多月，而這場選舉可能對近期漲勢強勁的AI類股，以及其他幾個產業造成影響。
花旗(Citi)在周二晚間發布的一份研究報告中提出了對即將到來選舉的預測。該行表示，如果民主黨拿下眾議院與參議院，並不會感到意外。
花旗美國股票策略師Scott Chronert表示，無論選舉結果如何，期中選舉很可能對標普500指數的基本面「不會造成太大影響」，但如果民主黨在兩院都取得控制權，可能會影響數個產業。
他表示，在這種情況下，保險、醫療保健設備與製藥類股可能表現相對良好，原因是市場預期民主黨將恢復先前失去的部分醫療保健保障。
Chronert補充指出，晶片投資人「偏好共和黨控制局面，可能與AI立法風險有關」，但他也指出，總統川普仍有權否決國會議員試圖推動的任何AI監管措施。
部分民主黨政治人物在期中選舉前已提出加強AI監管的主張。川普則拒絕放慢這項技術發展的呼籲，並表示美國有必要以比中國更快的速度推進AI發展。
通膨、經濟，以及伊朗戰爭，也是選民正在權衡的議題。
目前的市場預測顯示，共和黨可能難以維持眾議院或參議院其中任何一院的控制權。截至周三，預測平台Polymarket的交易價格反映出民主黨同時拿下參眾兩院的機率約為66%。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reports that the U.S. midterm election is just over a month away, and this election could affect AI stocks that have been rallying strongly recently, as well as several other industries.

Citi released a research report on Tuesday evening that offered forecasts for the upcoming election. The bank said it would not be surprised if the Democrats win control of both the House and the Senate.

Citi U.S. equity strategist Scott Chronert said that regardless of the election outcome, the midterms are unlikely to have a major impact on the fundamentals of the S&P 500, but if Democrats control both chambers, several sectors could be affected.

He noted that in that scenario, insurance, medical‑device and pharmaceutical stocks could perform relatively well, as the market expects Democrats to restore some of the healthcare coverage that was previously lost.

Chronert added that chip investors “prefer a Republican‑controlled environment, possibly due to AI‑legislation risk,” but he also pointed out that President Trump still has the authority to veto any AI regulatory measures that Congress members try to push.

Some Democratic politicians have already called for tighter AI regulation ahead of the midterms. Trump, however, rejected calls to slow the technology’s development and said the United States needs to advance AI faster than China.
Inflation, the economy, and the war in Iran are also issues voters are weighing.

Current market odds show that Republicans may find it difficult to retain control of either the House or the Senate. As of Wednesday, the prediction platform Polymarket’s trading prices reflected a roughly 66% probability that Democrats will win both chambers.

items.title_en: AI Optical Communications | CPO/NPO External Light Source ELSFP Moves Toward Mass Production, Guangchuang Lian Targets Q1 2027 Mass Production, Lianjun Enters Low‑Volume Production
paras: 2026年09月24日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI資料中心高速光互連持續升級，CPO、NPO外部光源開始從產品開發走向量產，其中可插拔外置雷射光源ELSFP的商用時程逐漸明朗。環旭電子(601231-CN)旗下光創聯推出UHP ELSFP外置光源模組系列，預計2026年第3季至第4季試產，最快2027年第1季量產。
CPO光源可分為內建與外接兩種架構，ELSFP則是外接光源的模組形式之一。隨交換器頻寬朝51.2T、102.4T提升，多通道光學引擎需要更高的總光功率，如果將雷射集中在封裝內，散熱及維修難度也會提高。ELSFP將雷射移至封裝外，再透過光纖將光導入光學引擎，有利降低封裝內的散熱壓力，同時保留維修與更換彈性。
目前供應鏈已陸續跨過研發階段。古河電工已開發符合ELSFP規範的16通道外置雷射光源並開始樣品出貨；銘普光磁(002902-CN)已啟動ELSFP樣品交付；天孚光通信(300394-CN)相關產品則進入小批量階段。
台灣供應鏈方面，聯鈞(3450-TW)也已推進至工程試產及小量生產。公司外部光源可同時應用於CPO與NPO，目前已與雷射晶片廠、終端客戶及系統設計業者共同開發，相關專案正處於design-in階段。
聯鈞切入外部光源的基礎主要來自高功率雷射封裝。公司具備EML與CW Laser封裝能力，雷射晶片功率已由過去70mW提高至300mW、400mW。隨功率提高，晶片尺寸放大，散熱及封裝難度同步增加，公司也從雷射晶片開發初期就與供應商共同開發。
高功率也是CPO光源的發展方向之一。Coherent目前已布局CPO與矽光子使用的高功率InP CW Laser，2026年展示的產品包括400mW高功率CW Laser。隨光學引擎通道數與傳輸容量增加，雷射輸出功率、波長控制及長時間穩定性要求也持續提高。
外部光源用量則是後續需求觀察重點。聯鈞表示，依目前取得的資訊，一個CPO模組可能需要18顆外部光源，未來CPO部署規模若擴大，外部光源需求也將跟著增加。
光創聯的量產時程則更明確，VPH及UPH系列工程樣品已於2025年第4季至2026年第2季完成，2026年第3季至第4季進入試產，預計2027年第1季正式量產。
不過，供應商具備量產能力後，實際出貨規模仍取決於下游客戶導入速度。聯鈞表示，ELSFP短期可能有小量出貨，但目前仍無法預估大規模出貨時間，主要取決於CPO、NPO實際導入時程。
目前可插拔光模組仍是資料中心高速光通訊主流，ELSFP則隨CPO、NPO逐步進入試產與量產階段。除了供應商量產進度，後續還要觀察光源可靠度、系統平台驗證，以及大型雲端服務商與交換器客戶的實際採用速度。
因此，2027年ELSFP產業的觀察重點，將逐步從產品能否量產，轉向CPO、NPO客戶何時擴大採用，以及實際訂單能否跟著增加。

paras_en: September 24, 2026 (U-Analysis / Industry Data Center report) – High‑speed optical interconnects in AI data centers continue to upgrade, and CPO and NPO external light sources are moving from product development to mass production. The commercial schedule for the pluggable external laser light source ELSFP is becoming clearer. Guangchuang Lian, a subsidiary of Hitevision Electronics (601231‑CN), has launched a series of UHP ELSFP external light‑source modules, with pilot production planned for Q3‑Q4 2026 and the earliest mass production in Q1 2027.

CPO light sources can be built with either internal or external architectures; ELSFP is one form of external‑light‑source module. As switch bandwidth climbs to 51.2 T and 102.4 T, multi‑channel optical engines require higher total optical power. Concentrating lasers inside the package raises thermal‑management and maintenance challenges. ELSFP moves the laser outside the package and feeds light into the optical engine via fiber, reducing internal heat stress while preserving flexibility for repair and replacement.

The supply chain has already moved past the R&D stage. Furukawa Electric has developed a 16‑channel external laser source that meets ELSFP specifications and has begun shipping samples; Mingpu Opto‑Magnetics (002902‑CN) has started delivering ELSFP samples; and Tianfu Optical Communications (300394‑CN) has entered a small‑batch production phase for related products.

In Taiwan, Lianjun (3450‑TW) has also progressed to engineering pilot runs and low‑volume production. Its external light source can be used for both CPO and NPO, and the company is co‑developing with laser‑chip manufacturers, end‑customers, and system designers. The related projects are currently in the design‑in stage.

Lianjun’s entry into external light sources is based mainly on high‑power laser packaging. The company has capabilities for EML and CW laser packaging, and laser‑chip output power has risen from the previous 70 mW to 300 mW and 400 mW. As power increases, chip size grows, and thermal and packaging difficulties rise accordingly; Lianjun has been co‑developing with suppliers since the early stages of laser‑chip development.

High power is also a key development direction for CPO light sources. Coherent has already positioned high‑power InP CW lasers for CPO and silicon‑photonic use, showcasing products in 2026 that include a 400 mW high‑power CW laser. With more channels in optical engines and higher transmission capacity, requirements for laser output power, wavelength control, and long‑term stability continue to rise.

The volume of external light sources will be a focal point for future demand. Lianjun notes that, based on current information, a single CPO module may need 18 external light sources; if CPO deployments expand, demand for external sources will grow accordingly.

Guangchuang Lian’s mass‑production timeline is now clearer: engineering samples of the VPH and UPH series were completed from Q4 2025 to Q2 2026, pilot production will run in Q3‑Q4 2026, and full‑scale mass production is slated for Q1 2027.

However, once suppliers have mass‑production capability, actual shipment volumes will still depend on the adoption speed of downstream customers. Lianjun says that ELSFP may see small shipments in the short term, but large‑scale shipment timing cannot yet be forecast and will hinge on the real‑world rollout schedules of CPO and NPO.

Currently, pluggable optical modules remain the mainstream for high‑speed data‑center optical communications, and ELSFP is gradually entering pilot and mass‑production phases alongside CPO and NPO. Beyond supplier production progress, future observation will need to focus on light‑source reliability, system‑platform validation, and the actual adoption speed by large cloud service providers and switch vendors.

Therefore, the key observation points for the ELSFP industry in 2027 will shift from whether the product can be mass‑produced to when CPO and NPO customers expand adoption and whether actual orders increase accordingly.

items.title: 日元再朝160邁進 匯市干預風險升溫
items.title_en: Yen Nears 160 Again, Forex Intervention Risk Rises
paras: 隨著日本假期結束，日元兌美元長達兩週的跌勢令匯率再度逼近 160 心理關卡，市場對日本政府發動外匯干預的戒心顯著增強。
儘管日本央行日前將政策利率升至 1.25%，但因總裁植田和男會後表態不如期待鷹派，加上美國聯準會可能維持緊縮政策，美日利差格局依然頑固，市場普遍對干預能否扭轉貶勢持審慎態度。

160關卡成試金石 多空角力加劇

澳洲聯邦銀行外匯策略師 Carol Kong 指出，若美債殖利率持續上升，且市場繼續測試日本捍衛日元的決心，美元兌日元可能很快突破 160 大關。她強調，考量到先前官方的匯率檢查(Rate Check)及美日協同干預先例，一旦快速衝破該門檻，當局出手干預的機率將大幅提高。
然而，澳洲國民銀行(NAB)外匯策略負責人 Ray Attrill 認為，雖然日元極可能再次探向 160，但「干預警戒感本身或將暫時阻礙其突破」。
Attrill 補充，日本單獨干預的效果通常較為短暫，市場很快會消化其影響，欲實現持續反轉，美國的參與至關重要。若日元重回 160，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)捍衛強勢日元的信念將面臨考驗，美方再次支援的前提可能取決於日本是否展現超越市場預期的升息決心。

基本面不利 單靠干預難治本

金融服務公司 Ebury 市場策略負責人 Matthew Ryan 強調，外匯干預僅是暫時抑壓賣壓的手段，若缺乏強有力的貨幣政策配合，日本當局很難壓制日元走貶。瑞銀資產管理(UBS Asset Management)全球主權與貨幣固定收益主管 Kevin Zhao 甚至表示，若政府干預引發日元短暫反彈，他將視為「逢高賣出日元」的時機。
Zhao 分析，驅動日元疲軟的基本面政策並未改變，日本首相高市早苗維持擴張性財政政策，在巨額國債下偏好低利率環境，且「安倍經濟學並不代表強勢日元」。此外，即使日本央行升息，若聯準會亦同步升息，美日利差便難以收窄，單靠升息無法維持日元強勢。
瑞銀集團策略師 Shahab Jalinoos 等人也在報告中指出，數據顯示投機客先前的日元空頭部位已完全消化，在套利交易環境持續有利且美日利差仍大的背景下，投資人重新建立日元賣壓部位的空間已經打開。
paras_en: As the Japanese holiday ends, the yen's two‑week slide against the dollar has brought the exchange rate close to the psychological 160 level again, heightening market wariness of a possible foreign‑exchange intervention by the Japanese government.

Even though the Bank of Japan recently raised its policy rate to 1.25%, the tone of Governor Kazuo Ueda after the meeting was less hawkish than expected, and with the U.S. Federal Reserve likely to maintain a tight stance, the US‑Japan rate‑differential remains stubborn, leading markets to take a cautious view on whether intervention can reverse the yen's decline.

The 160 threshold is a litmus test, intensifying the tug‑of‑war between bulls and bears. Australian Commonwealth Bank FX strategist Carol Kong notes that if U.S. Treasury yields keep rising and markets continue testing Japan's resolve to defend the yen, the USD/JPY pair could soon break the 160 barrier. She stresses that, given past official rate checks and US‑Japan coordinated‑intervention precedents, a rapid breach would greatly increase the odds of authorities stepping in.
However, NAB FX strategy head Ray Attrill believes that while the yen is very likely to test 160 again, “the very sense of intervention caution itself may temporarily impede its breakthrough.”

Attrill adds that solo Japanese intervention tends to be short‑lived, with markets quickly absorbing its effect; a sustained reversal would require U.S. participation. If the yen returns to 160, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s belief in a strong yen will be tested, and any renewed U.S. support may hinge on Japan showing rate‑hike resolve beyond market expectations.

Fundamentals are unfavorable, making intervention alone insufficient. Ebury market strategist Matthew Ryan stresses that FX intervention only temporarily suppresses selling pressure, and without strong monetary policy backing, Japanese authorities will struggle to curb yen depreciation. UBS Asset Management sovereign‑and‑currency fixed‑income head Kevin Zhao even says that a brief yen rally sparked by government action would be a “sell‑the‑rally” opportunity.

Zhao analyses that the fundamental policies driving yen weakness have not changed: Prime Minister Kishida maintains expansionary fiscal policy despite massive debt, favoring a low‑rate environment, and “Abenomics does not imply a strong yen.” Moreover, even if the BOJ hikes rates, a simultaneous Fed hike would keep the US‑Japan spread wide, so rate hikes alone cannot sustain yen strength.

UBS Group strategists including Shahab Jalinoos note that data show speculative short‑yen positions have been fully absorbed. With arbitrage conditions still favorable and the US‑Japan rate spread remaining large, investors now have room to rebuild yen‑selling pressure.

消息人士向路透透露，沙烏地阿拉伯的東西向輸油管道已恢復營運，亦可能已恢復從紅海延布港出口原油，並據美國總統川普表示，與伊朗總統佩澤希齊揚在紐約舉行的會談取得進展，重燃中東和平的希望，導致油價跌至兩周低位，降低美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)進一步升息的可能性，削弱美元作為能源出口國貨幣的支撐，同時為投資人此前拋售日圓和歐元等淨能源進口國的貨幣提供支撐，而且儘管市場認為日本央行(BOJ)上周升息的鷹派力度不足，但週三仍為日本假期休市，這段流動性較低的時期可能是當局在必要時進行干預的最佳時機，投資人對干預威脅保持警惕支撐日圓，打壓美元兌日圓至157.30低點。

據標準普爾(S&P)全球初值調查顯示，美國9月製造業與服務業採購經理人指數(PMI)分別升至57.0及58.7，綜合PMI上揚至2021年7月以來最高達58.4，新訂單指數亦躍升至58.2，創2022年3月以來新高，而且美FED理事巴爾認為FED上周採取了重新校準短期借貸成本的重要舉措，以推動通貨膨脹回落，未來可能需要進一步加息，提振美元兌日圓至158.39高點。預估今日美元兌日圓支撐於157.90-158.10，阻力於159.00-20。
◆EUR/USD

市場對澳洲央行(RBA)的利率預期轉變，幾乎肯定其9月29日會議上調利率至4.6%，亦關注其是否保留11月再加息的可能性，提振澳幣兌加元逾八年來首度平價，但昨日據S&P全球初值調查，澳洲9月製造業與服務業PMI分別降至49.3及51.4，綜合PMI亦跌至50.8，市場亦預計紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)下月升息的概率達75%，但紐西蘭利率仍低於許多發達經濟體，而且美元買盤強勁，壓抑澳幣和紐元，拖累歐元兌美元受限於1.1452高點。

隨著S&P全球9月綜合PMI初值調查顯示，法國升至逾兩年最高51.2，德國則創去年10月以來新高53.8，歐元區亦跳升至2023年4月以來最高53.1，但歐洲央行(ECB)管理委員會委員馬赫盧夫稱，若高能源價格傳導至其他領域，ECB不得不再加息，但目前未出現第二輪通貨膨脹效應，而且油價連續六個交易日下跌，ECB再升息的預期減弱，打壓歐元兌美元至1.1367低點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1375-95，支撐於1.1300附近。
◆GBP/USD

週三據人力資源數據公司Brightmine數據顯示，在截至7月的三個月，薪資漲幅中位數下修至3.0%，表明英國雇主提供的薪資漲幅有所放緩，進一步表明勞動力市場趨於疲軟，打擊英鎊兌美元自1.3348高點走低。隨後數據顯示，S&P全球9月英國服務業PMI初值降至三個月新低51.7，作為英國經濟支柱的服務業企業收取的價格漲幅則創四個月來最高水平，突顯商業活動放緩，通貨膨脹壓力加劇，對即將於下個月公布首份預算案的財政大臣希利而言，無疑是一個棘手的局面，重創英鎊兌美元跌至1.3220低點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3220-40，支撐於1.3120-40。

Sources told Reuters that Saudi Arabia’s east‑west oil pipeline has resumed operations and may have also restarted crude exports from the Red Sea’s Yanbu port. According to U.S. President Trump, talks between him and Iranian President Raisi in New York made progress, reviving hopes for Middle‑East peace. This pushed oil prices down to a two‑week low, reducing the likelihood of further Fed rate hikes, weakening the dollar’s support as an energy‑exporting currency, and providing support for investors who had previously sold yen and euro, the net importers of energy. Although the market views the Bank of Japan’s recent rate hike as insufficiently hawkish, Japan’s market was closed on Wednesday for a holiday, creating a low‑liquidity window that could be the optimal time for authorities to intervene if needed. Investors remain vigilant for intervention threats, supporting the yen and pushing USD/JPY down to a low of 157.30.

According to the S&P Global flash survey, U.S. September manufacturing and services PMI rose to 57.0 and 58.7 respectively, lifting the composite PMI to a July 2021 high of 58.4. The new‑orders index jumped to 58.2, the strongest since March 2022. Fed Governor Bostic said the Fed’s recent move to recalibrate short‑term borrowing costs was an important step to bring inflation down and may require further hikes, boosting the dollar to a high of 158.39 against the yen. The dollar/yen pair is expected to find support around 157.90‑158.10 today, with resistance near 159.00‑20.
EUR/USD

Market expectations for the Reserve Bank of Australia have shifted, with a near‑certain rate hike to 4.6% at the September 29 meeting and attention on whether a further hike in November will be kept on the table. This lifted the AUD/CAD to parity for the first time in over eight years. However, S&P Global’s flash survey showed Australia’s September manufacturing and services PMI fell to 49.3 and 51.4, with the composite PMI slipping to 50.8. The market also estimates a 75% chance of a rate hike by the Reserve Bank of New Zealand next month, though NZ rates remain lower than many advanced economies. Strong dollar buying pressure is suppressing both the Aussie and Kiwi, limiting EUR/USD to a high of 1.1452.

As the S&P Global September composite PMI flash survey showed, France’s index rose to a two‑year high of 51.2, Germany hit a post‑October 2022 peak of 53.8, and the Euro‑area jumped to its highest since April 2023 at 53.1. ECB Governing Council member Makhlouf warned that if high energy prices spill over into other sectors, the ECB may have to raise rates again, but a second‑round inflation effect has not yet materialised and oil prices have fallen for six consecutive sessions, weakening expectations of further ECB hikes and pushing EUR/USD down to a low of 1.1367. EUR/USD is expected to face resistance around 1.1375‑95 today, with support near 1.1300.

Subsequent data showed the S&P Global September UK services PMI fell to a three‑month low of 51.7, while price gains for service firms hit a four‑month peak, highlighting slowing business activity and heightened inflation pressure. This creates a tricky situation for Finance Minister Hilary Benn ahead of next month’s first budget and drove GBP/USD down to a low of 1.3220. GBP/USD is expected to encounter resistance around 1.3220‑40 today, with support near 1.3120‑40.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元升至近兩個月高點 Fed短期內升息預期增
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Rises to Near Two-Month High as Fed Rate-Hike Expectations Increase
paras: 美元周三(23日)大幅上漲，升至近兩個月來最高，因投資人對聯準會(Fed)短期內升息的預期升溫。同時，伊朗對和平談判進展表示懷疑，推動油價大漲。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.51%，報101.06，盤中一度升至101.23，創7月29日以來最高。
聯準會上周升息25個基點，將利率區間調升至3.75%至4.00%後，多名聯準會官員已表示，如果通膨未能降溫，可能需要進一步升息。
聯準會理事巴爾(Michael Barr)周三表示，美國央行上周採取重要措施，重新「校準」短期借貸成本，以降低通膨，而未來可能還需要進一步升息。
Brown Brothers Harriman全球市場策略主管Elias Haddad表示，「目前市場關注的就是利率。」
「推動美元走高的是上周聯準會鷹派升息後的延續效應，這為美元帶來新的動能。本周公布的數據不多，與政策相關的數據更少，但有趣的是聯準會官員的談話，他們基本上都在傳達相同訊息，也就是未來還會進一步緊縮。」
在標普全球(S&P Global)公布綜合PMI產出指數初值後，美元漲幅進一步擴大。該指數涵蓋製造業與服務業，本月升至58.4，創2021年7月以來最高，高於8月的56.0。新訂單大幅增加帶動整體活動，但強勁需求也使供應鏈承受壓力，並推升價格。
根據LSEG數據，在上述數據公布後，市場對聯準會10月會議至少升息25個基點的預期升溫，目前機率約為70%，高於數據公布前的約53%。
中東緊張局勢推升油價
進一步推動美元上漲的因素還包括油價走高。伊朗最高國家安全委員會秘書Mohsen Rezaei接受伊朗國營電視台訪問時表示，只要伊朗提出的條件沒有獲得滿足，荷姆茲海峽(Strait of Hormuz)就不會重新開放，也不會進行談判。
此外，一名伊朗高級官員告訴《路透社》，伊朗與美國對如何結束戰爭仍存在重大分歧，但外交努力必須持續。此前，伊朗總統在聯合國大會上表示，德黑蘭永遠不會屈服於美國壓力。
外界原本希望聯合國大會期間的外交活動能促成這場持續7個月的伊朗戰爭達成解決方案，相關希望曾推動油價自9月中觸及4個月高點後回落，但本周市場情勢已出現逆轉。
芝加哥聯準銀行總裁古爾斯比(Austan Goolsbee)表示，聯準會需要「保持謹慎」，並可能需要將目前的能源衝擊視為持續性通膨來源，而不能預期其自行消退。
歐元走弱、日元承壓
歐元兌美元下跌0.51%至1.1389美元，連續第三個交易日走跌，並創一周來最大單日跌幅。
稍早公布的標普全球歐元區綜合PMI產出指數初值顯示，儘管中東與烏克蘭衝突推升企業與家庭的能源成本，但歐元區經濟仍展現出意外的韌性。
投資人也在等待美國總統川普與中國國家主席習近平會面，兩大強權目前在貿易、科技以及伊朗戰爭等議題上存在分歧。

日元兌美元貶值0.52%，至158.19日元兌1美元。

paras_en: The dollar surged sharply on Wednesday (the 23rd), reaching its highest level in nearly two months as investors’ expectations for a near‑term Fed rate hike warmed. At the same time, Iran expressed doubts about progress in peace talks, pushing oil prices sharply higher.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.51% to 101.06, briefly climbing to 101.23 intraday – the highest since July 29.
The Fed raised rates by 25 basis points last week, moving the target range to 3.75%‑4.00%. Several Fed officials have since said that if inflation does not cool, further hikes may be needed.

Fed Governor Michael Barr said on Wednesday that the central bank took an important step last week to “re‑calibrate” short‑term borrowing costs to curb inflation, and that additional hikes could still be required.
Elias Haddad, head of global market strategy at Brown Brothers Harriman, said, “The market’s focus right now is on rates.”

“What is driving the dollar higher is the lingering effect of last week’s hawkish Fed hike, which gives the greenback fresh momentum. There are few data releases this week and even fewer policy‑related numbers, but the interesting part is the Fed officials’ remarks – they are essentially delivering the same message: further tightening is likely ahead.”

After S&P Global released the flash composite PMI output index, the dollar’s gains widened further. The index, covering manufacturing and services, rose to 58.4 this month – the highest since July 2021 and above August’s 56.0. Strong new orders lifted overall activity, but robust demand also strained supply chains and pushed up prices.

LSEG data show that after the PMI release, market expectations that the Fed will raise rates by at least 25 basis points at its October meeting rose to roughly 70%, up from about 53% before the data were out.
Middle‑East tensions lift oil prices

Another factor pushing the dollar higher is the rise in oil prices. In an interview with Iran’s state TV, Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of the Supreme National Security Council, said that unless Iran’s conditions are met, the Strait of Hormuz will not be reopened and negotiations will not resume.

A senior Iranian official told Reuters that Iran and the United States still have major disagreements on how to end the war, but diplomatic efforts must continue. Earlier, Iran’s president said at the UN General Assembly that Tehran will never bow to U.S. pressure.

Outside observers had hoped that diplomatic activity during the UN General Assembly would produce a solution to the seven‑month‑long Iran conflict, a hope that had helped oil prices retreat from a four‑month high reached in mid‑September. This week, market sentiment has reversed.

Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee said the Fed needs to “stay cautious” and may have to treat the current energy shock as a persistent source of inflation rather than assuming it will fade on its own.
Euro weakens, yen under pressure
The euro fell 0.51% against the dollar to $1.1389, marking a third consecutive trading‑day decline and the biggest single‑day drop in a week.

A flash composite PMI for the euro area released earlier showed that despite higher energy costs for businesses and households from the Middle‑East and Ukraine conflicts, the European economy displayed unexpected resilience.
Investors are also awaiting a meeting between U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping, as the two powers remain at odds on trade, technology and the Iran war.
The dollar rose 0.17% against offshore yuan to 6.71 yuan.
The yen weakened 0.52% to 158.19 per dollar.

The Bank of Japan raised rates last week to the highest level in 31 years, but it has not convinced investors that further hikes are coming; traders are watching closely for any sign of intervention in the FX market.
Analysts note that Japan’s market is currently thin on liquidity due to a string of holidays, which could increase the likelihood of authorities stepping in.

items.title: 印尼央行維持基準利率5.75%不變 擴大避險誘因以穩定印尼盾
items.title_en: Indonesia Central Bank Keeps Benchmark Rate at 5.75% to Expand Hedging Incentives and Stabilize the Rupiah
paras: 印尼央行周三(23日)宣布將基準利率(7天期逆回購利率)維持在5.75%，為連續第三次按兵不動。隔夜存款利率與貸款利率分別維持於4.75%及6.5%。這是Destry Damayanti就任印尼央行首位女性總裁後的首次政策會議，決議符合市場預期。
印尼央行曾在今年5月與6月累計升息100個基點以捍衛匯率。總裁Damayanti表示，當前政策旨在維持印尼盾穩定、控制通膨並支撐經濟成長。
面對中東局勢、油價漲破每桶100美元及聯準會可能升息等外部不確定性，央行選擇採取非利率的創新政策工具，進一步調降外資避險成本(避險換匯貼息調降最高25%、國內無本金交割遠期外匯調降最高30%)，並採取「資金停留愈久、優惠愈高」的機制吸引外資流入。
決議公布後，印尼盾升值約0.4%至17,800對美元，股市大漲1.5%。
印尼8月通膨率升至3.19%，仍處於1.5%至3.5%的目標區間；央行維持2026年GDP成長預測於4.9%至5.7%不變。
市場對後續走勢看法分歧，巴克萊銀行預期利率將一路凍漲至2027年，但也有分析師認為，若高油價與聯準會升息壓力持續，央行第四季仍可能追加升息25個基點。
paras_en: Indonesia’s central bank on Wednesday (the 23rd) announced that it will keep the benchmark rate (the 7‑day reverse‑repo rate) at 5.75%, marking the third consecutive meeting of a hold. The overnight deposit rate and loan rate remain at 4.75% and 6.5% respectively. This was the first policy meeting after Destry Damayanti became the bank’s first female governor, and the decision matched market expectations.

The bank had raised rates by a total of 100 basis points in May and June of this year to defend the exchange rate. Governor Damayanti said the current policy aims to keep the rupiah stable, contain inflation and support economic growth.

Facing external uncertainties such as the Middle‑East situation, oil prices breaking $100 a barrel and the possibility of further Fed hikes, the central bank chose to use non‑rate innovative tools, further lowering the cost of hedging for foreign investors (reducing hedging‑exchange premium by up to 25% and domestic non‑deliverable forward premiums by up to 30%) and adopting a “the longer the funds stay, the higher the incentive” mechanism to attract foreign inflows.
After the decision was announced, the rupiah appreciated about 0.4% to around 17,800 per US dollar, and the stock market jumped 1.5%.
Indonesia’s August inflation rose to 3.19%, still within the 1.5%‑3.5% target band; the central bank kept its 2026 GDP growth forecast unchanged at 4.9%‑5.7%.

Market views on the next move diverge: Barclays expects rates to stay frozen until 2027, while some analysts argue that if high oil prices and Fed‑rate pressure persist, the bank could still add a 25‑basis‑point hike in the fourth quarter.

芝加哥聯邦儲備銀行總裁古爾斯比與聖路易斯聯邦儲備銀行總裁穆薩萊姆均主張美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)進一步升息，並據美國總統川普表示願意會見將出席紐約舉行的聯合國大會的伊朗總統佩澤希齊揚，重燃兩國重啟談判的希望，導致油價下跌，提振市場情緒，而且日本央行(BOJ)上周調升利率，但兩名委員反對加息及缺乏明確鷹派指引，市場押注BOJ難以跟上全球主要央行的鷹派步伐，讓日本與主要經濟體之間維持較大利率差距，令日圓承壓，週二適逢日本假期休市，交投清淡，推動美元兌日圓觸及157.77高點。

據波士頓聯邦儲備銀行總裁柯林斯發文稱，因未來通貨膨脹持續高於2%目標的風險上升，支持FED上周加息，里奇蒙聯邦儲備銀行總裁巴爾金亦稱，美國經濟越來越強勁，通貨膨脹風險仍占上風，但上周傳言日本曾對美元兌日圓詢價，此舉被視為當局入市干預的前兆，限制日圓走貶，並據美國總統川普表示，伊朗一直與美國進行接觸，認為兩國最終將達成協議，而且油價下跌，緩解通貨膨脹擔憂，打壓美元兌日圓至156.80低點。預估今日美元兌日圓支撐於156.90-157.10，阻力於157.80-158.00。
◆EUR/USD

昨日紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)總裁布雷曼表示，經濟復甦和通貨膨脹前景面臨風險，但澳洲央行(RBA)助理總裁亨特重申，今年可能不得不第四次加息以控制通貨膨脹，並據RBA總裁布洛克稱，鑒於能源價格居高不下且國內需求持續過度，通貨膨脹面臨的上行風險可能正在顯現，市場分別加大押注RBA與RBNZ再加息，提振澳幣和紐元，而且消息人士透露，德國主要經濟研究機構包括WI研究所、伊福經濟研究所、IfW智庫、IWH以及DIW分別將今、明兩年經濟增長預期上調至1.3%及1.1%，帶動歐元兌美元盤整於1.1478高點。

隨後歐洲央行(ECB)首席經濟學家連恩表示，推高油氣價格的能源衝擊持續時間恐比ECB在3月預期的要長，地緣政治風險似乎再次升高，並據ECB指出，中國工業轉型正在將歐洲企業擠出全球市場，機械設備與運輸設備行業受影響尤為顯著，其中德國企業遭遇的衝擊最大，而且歐元區9月消費者信心指數較前月降1.0點至負16.5，推低歐元兌美元匯價至1.1428低點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1450-70，支撐於1.1370-90。
◆GBP/USD

週二英國數據顯示8月公共部門借款達183億英鎊高於預期，並上修2026/27財政年前四個月借款數據，累計赤字再超出官方預測，增添財政大臣希首份預算案前壓力，打擊英鎊兌美元自1.3387高點下滑。據英國工業聯盟(CBI)公布9月工業訂單差值升至負9，但伊朗提議重開荷姆茲海峽，推動油價下跌，減輕英國央行(BOE)升息壓力，導致英鎊兌美元跌至1.3318低點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3340-60，支撐於1.3250-70。

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元徘徊近8周高點 Fed官員強調通膨風險
items.title_en: <New York FX> Dollar Hovers Near 8-Week High as Fed Officials Emphasize Inflation Risks
paras: 美元周二(22日)上漲，延續上周聯準會(Fed)升息帶來的提振。歐元則在疲軟的消費者信心數據公布後走低。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.1%，報100.54，創7月29日以來最高。
聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)上周三一致投票決定，將聯邦資金利率從3.50%-3.75%上調至3.75%-4.00%。此外，聯準會更新的經濟預測摘要顯示，至少有12名FOMC成員預期今年還會再升息一次，而聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在決策後記者會上也明顯釋出鷹派訊號。
較高的利率環境通常有利於美元走強。自聯準會升息以來，美元已上漲近1%。
波士頓聯準銀行總裁柯林斯(Susan Collins)周二再次表示支持FOMC 的決定。她在社群媒體貼文中強調，偏高的價格壓力要求採取更具限制性的政策立場，以實現長期物價穩定。
她表示，近期經濟指標顯示，在成本持續偏高超過五年後，未來出現「通膨明顯高於2%」情境的可能性有所增加。
另外，里奇蒙聯準銀行總裁巴金(Tom Barkin)也支持FOMC的升息決定，並表示，目前通膨風險高於充分就業所面臨的風險。
油價成為市場焦點
本月一大主題，就是因能源推動的價格壓力而進行的央行升息，歐洲央行(ECB)與日本銀行(BoJ)也都在收緊貨幣政策。在此背景下，近期油價持續下跌，已引起外匯市場參與者關注。
原油基準價格已連續五個交易日下跌，原因包括市場對供應中斷的擔憂有所緩解，以及對中東外交取得進展的期待。交易員對沙烏地阿拉伯採取果斷措施感到振奮，以抵消一條重要管線關閉所造成的影響，該管線是在與伊朗支持的葉門武裝組織「青年運動」(Houthis)衝突擴大期間受損。
美國總統川普本周在聯合國大會期間，可能與伊朗代表團，包括外交部長及總統會面的可能性，也改善了市場情緒。川普周二在聯合國發表演講時表示，他認為華府與德黑蘭之間的協議將在即將於11月舉行的美國期中選舉後達成。
Macquarie全球外匯與利率策略師Thierry Wizman表示，「本周發生的事情可能成為決定原油價格中期走向的關鍵。因為美伊戰爭的關鍵參與者將從今天開始在紐約舉行會談。而這些會談所達成的協議與共識，可能決定戰爭是否持續並升級，或是否能找到退出衝突的途徑。」
他指出，「原油價格的走向仍會影響全球通膨，以及各國央行對此所採取的決策。我們已看到每家主要央行(包括美國聯準會)都提到能源價格或『地緣政治』是未來決策的一項驅動因素。這也是近期『鷹派』言論背後的關鍵原因。」
Wizman補充，「我們仍將較高的油價與美元兌主要貨幣走強聯繫在一起。這並不是因為高油價會導致聯準會升息，如果油價進一步上漲，所有央行都會轉鷹。原因在於，美國經濟成長與美元會透過貿易條件改善及實質所得效應，從高油價中受益。我們認為，美伊戰爭透過讓原油價格維持高檔，已成為今年支撐美元強勢的重要因素。」
歐元走弱 日元小幅走低
歐元兌美元下跌0.2%，至1.1448 美元。稍早公布數據顯示，歐元區9月消費者信心較8月轉弱，此前已連續四個月回升。
另一方面，日本銀行上周升息後，日元一度加速貶值，如今跌勢暫歇，匯價變化不大。美元兌日元略高於持平水準，報157.38。
由於日本正在放連續假期，亞洲交易部門成交量偏低。外匯配置機構警告，這種季節性交易低迷可能大幅放大市場波動，以及央行行動所帶來的影響。
《日本經濟新聞》報導，日銀已與外匯交易部門進行正式的「匯率詢價」，引發市場焦慮升溫。此程序是指央行官員致電商業銀行，詢問即時可執行的匯率報價。
儘管日元在日銀非一致決議升息25個基點後持續走弱，使借貸成本升至31年高點，但市場策略師指出，東京擁有龐大的政策火力。日本持有估計約1兆美元的外匯存底，為當局提供充足的流動性。
